text: The ESA sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
quote: The sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
test_case: Inspect the submitted lamp samples for a legible, indelible trade name/mark and type designation; pass if both are present and survive a rub test.

text: ESA which are brought to the market as replacement parts do not need a type approval only if they are obviously marked as a replacement part by an identification number and if they are identical and from the same manufacturer as the corresponding original equipment.
quote: ESA which are brought to the market as replacement parts do not need a type approval if they are obviously marked as a replacement part
condition: Lamp is supplied as a replacement part without its own R10 type approval
test_case: Check that the replacement lamp carries an identification number marking it as a replacement part and is identical to, and from the same manufacturer as, the OE part.

text: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128 granted to this ESA, or provide a test report by a Technical Service stating that this ESA is not mechanically interchangeable with any light source according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128.
quote: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall: (a) Specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37
condition: The LED module/ESA is (part of) a light source
test_case: Check that either an R37/R99/R128 approval number for the LED light source or a Technical Service report of mechanical non-interchangeability is available.

text: Components sold as aftermarket equipment and intended for installation in motor vehicles that are not related to immunity related functions need no type approval only if a declaration is issued by the manufacturer that the ESA fulfils the requirements of this Regulation and in particular the limits defined in paragraphs 6.5., 6.6., 6.7., 6.8. and 6.9.
quote: In this case a declaration shall be issued by the manufacturer that the ESA fulfils the requirements of this Regulation
condition: Lamp is sold as aftermarket equipment without type approval
test_case: Verify that a manufacturer declaration of compliance with paragraphs 6.5. to 6.9. limits exists for the aftermarket lamp.

text: The representative ESA system(s) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 6. and, if applicable, paragraph 7. of this Regulation for type approval to be granted.
quote: If the representative ESA system(s) fulfil(s) the requirements of paragraph 6. and, if applicable, paragraph 7. of this Regulation, type approval shall be granted.
test_case: Review the R10 test report for the representative lamp; pass if all paragraph 6. requirements are met.

text: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source and if the documentation as specified in paragraph 3.2.10. is missing, approval of this ESA according to Regulation No. 10 shall not be granted.
quote: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source and if the documentation as specified in paragraph 3.2.10. above is missing
condition: The LED module/ESA is (part of) a light source
test_case: Confirm that the paragraph 3.2.10. documentation is present before R10 approval; fail if missing.

text: The electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) conforming to a type approved under this Regulation shall have an approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. affixed to it, except that no marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
quote: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.
test_case: Inspect the production lamp for an R10 approval mark per paragraph 5.3.; pass if present (unless approved as part of a vehicle unit).

text: The approval mark shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
quote: A circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
test_case: Inspect the approval mark on the lamp for a circle with letter E and the approving country's number.

text: The approval mark shall comprise the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1.
quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle
test_case: Inspect the mark for '10R-' followed by the approval number placed to the right of the E-circle.

text: The electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
quote: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle
test_case: Verify by R10 ESA test results and design review that the lamp electronics allow the vehicle to meet R10 in normal use.

text: The ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
quote: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
test_case: Check that the lamp test report covers radiated emissions, conducted emissions, radiated immunity and conducted immunity tests with pass results.

text: Before testing, a test plan shall be prepared in conjunction with the manufacturer, which contains at least mode of operation, stimulated function(s), monitored function(s), pass/fail criterion(criteria) and intended emissions.
quote: the Technical Service shall prepare a test plan in conjunction with the manufacturer, which contains at least mode of operation, stimulated function(s), monitored function(s)
test_case: Review the EMC test plan for the lamp; pass if it defines operating modes, stimulated and monitored functions, pass/fail criteria and intended emissions.

text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
quote: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
test_case: Check the test report shows broadband radiated emission measured per the Annex 7 method.
merged: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
quote: the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically
test_case: Measure broadband emission per Annex 7 from 30 to 75 MHz; pass if below the log-decreasing 62 to 52 dBµV/m limit.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
quote: 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz
test_case: Measure broadband emission per Annex 7 from 75 to 400 MHz; pass if below the log-increasing 52 to 63 dBµV/m limit of Appendix 6.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
test_case: Measure broadband emission per Annex 7 from 400 to 1,000 MHz; pass if below 63 dBµV/m.
merged: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.

text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
test_case: Compare broadband measured values with the 6.5.2.1 limits; pass if all values are below the limits.
merged: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured value, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits.
On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dBµV/m, shall be below the type approval limits.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
quote: the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically
condition: ESA includes an electronic oscillator with operating frequency greater than 9 kHz
test_case: Measure narrowband emission per Annex 8 from 30 to 75 MHz; pass if below the log-decreasing 52 to 42 dBµV/m limit.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limits shall be 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
quote: 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz
condition: ESA includes an electronic oscillator with operating frequency greater than 9 kHz
test_case: Measure narrowband emission per Annex 8 from 75 to 400 MHz; pass if below the log-increasing 42 to 53 dBµV/m limit of Appendix 7.

text: The emission of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
quote: The emission of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10
condition: ESA is switched, contains switches or includes inductive load (otherwise exempt per 6.10.5)
test_case: Check transient conducted emission tested per ISO 7637-2 / Annex 10.

text: The maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude of transient conducted emission of the ESA shall be +75 V for vehicles with 12 V systems and +150 V for vehicles with 24 V systems, as given in Table 1.
quote: Maximum allowed pulse amplitude for Polarity of pulse amplitude Vehicles with 12 V systems Vehicles with 24 V systems Positive +75 V +150 V
condition: ESA is switched, contains switches or includes inductive load
test_case: Measure transient emission per ISO 7637-2; pass if positive pulses do not exceed +75 V (12 V) / +150 V (24 V).
merged: The maximum allowed negative pulse amplitude of transient conducted emission of the ESA shall be -100 V for vehicles with 12 V systems and -450 V for vehicles with 24 V systems, as given in Table 1.

text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
quote: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
condition: ESA has immunity related functions (otherwise exempt per 6.10.3)
test_case: Check radiated immunity tested using one or more Annex 9 methods.

text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) as described in Annex 9 with the test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2a and the test severity for the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2b.
quote: Test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a.
condition: ESA has immunity related functions
test_case: Verify test plan applies Table 2a and Table 2b severities for the chosen Annex 9 method.

text: For the BCI method, the ESA shall be tested at 60 mA in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range (Table 2a) and at a minimum of 50 mA over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency range (Table 2b).
quote: Test level below 2 GHz 50 V/m 62,5 V/m 50 mA 25 V/m 18 V/m
condition: ESA has immunity related functions and BCI method is chosen
test_case: Verify BCI injection current of 60 mA (>90 %) and minimum 50 mA over 20-400 MHz with no degradation.
merged: For the stripline method, the ESA shall be tested at 60 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range (Table 2a) and at a minimum of 50 V/m over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency range (Table 2b).

text: For the ALSE method, the ESA shall be tested at 30 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 80 to 2,000 MHz frequency range and 10 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency range (Table 2a), and at a minimum of 25 V/m over the whole 80 to 2,000 MHz and 8 V/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency range (Table 2b).
quote: Frequency range above 2 GHz Not applicable Not applicable Not applicable 2,000 to 6,000 MHz 2,000 to 6,000 MHz Test level above 2 GHz
condition: ESA has immunity related functions and ALSE method is chosen
test_case: Verify ALSE field levels 30/10 V/m (>90 %) and minimum 25/8 V/m in the respective bands with no degradation.

text: For the TEM cell method, the ESA shall be tested at 75 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 200 MHz frequency range (Table 2a) and at a minimum of 62,5 V/m over the whole 20 to 200 MHz frequency range (Table 2b).
quote: Test level below 2 GHz 60 V/m 75 V/m 60 mA 30 V/m 21 V/m
condition: ESA has immunity related functions and TEM cell method is chosen
test_case: Verify TEM cell field levels of 75 V/m (>90 %) and minimum 62,5 V/m over 20-200 MHz with no degradation.

text: For the reverberation chamber method, the ESA shall be tested at 21 V/m in over 90 per cent of the LUF to 2,000 MHz frequency range and 7 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency range (Table 2a), and at a minimum of 18 V/m over the whole LUF to 2,000 MHz and 6 V/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency range (Table 2b).
quote: Test level above 2 GHz Not applicable Not applicable Not applicable 8 V/m 6 V/m
condition: ESA has immunity related functions and reverberation chamber method is chosen
test_case: Verify reverberation chamber levels 21/7 V/m (>90 %) and minimum 18/6 V/m in the respective bands with no degradation.

text: Where an ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.6.2. and with Annex 8.
quote: does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.3.2. or 6.6.2.
condition: ESA has no electronic oscillator with operating frequency greater than 9 kHz
test_case: Review circuit documentation; if no oscillator >9 kHz, narrowband test may be waived.

text: While tests are performed in accordance with Annex 9, the ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if there is no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
quote: shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation
condition: ESA has immunity related functions
test_case: Monitor lamp functions during Annex 9 tests; pass if no degradation of immunity related functions occurs.

text: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
quote: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2
test_case: Check conducted transient immunity tested per ISO 16750-2 and ISO 7637-2 / Annex 10 at Tables 3a and 3b levels.

text: The starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
quote: Starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
test_case: Verify starting profile results are classified per ISO 16750-1 functional status.

text: The Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
quote: Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
test_case: Verify pulse results are classified per ISO 7637-1 FPSC.

text: For pulse 1, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -75 V (12V system) or -450 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC III for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
quote: 1 -75 V -450 V 500 pulses III III
test_case: Apply pulse 1 at -75 V / -450 V for 500 pulses; pass if FPSC III is reached.
merged: For pulse 2a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +37 V (12V system) or +37 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.

For pulse 2b, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +10 V (12V system) or +20 V (24V system) for 10 pulses with FPSC II for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.

For pulse 3b, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +75 V (12V system) or +150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.

text: For pulse 3a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -112 V (12V system) or -150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
quote: 3a -112 V -150 V 1 h I III
test_case: Apply pulse 3a at -112 V / -150 V for 1 h; pass if FPSC I (immunity related) / III (other) is reached.

text: For the 12 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.
quote: Starting profile II II 10 pulses (for ESA which shall be operational during engine start phases) C (for other ESA)
condition: Lamp may be installed in a vehicle with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V starter motor
test_case: Apply starting profile level II, 10 pulses; pass if the functional status class meets B/D/C as applicable.
merged: For the 24 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.

text: ESAs with no immunity related functions need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.8. and with Annex 9 to this Regulation.
quote: ESAs with no immunity related functions need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.8.
condition: ESA has no immunity related functions
test_case: Review function analysis; if no immunity related functions, radiated immunity test may be waived.

text: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.
quote: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission
condition: ESA is not switched, contains no switches or includes no inductive load
test_case: Review circuit design; if criteria met, transient conducted emission test may be waived.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 62 to 52 dBµV/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dBµV/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6, and in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dBµV/m.
quote: the limits shall be 62 to 52 dBµV/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz
condition: Only if the ESA is used in the 'REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid' configuration, which a rear lamp normally is not
test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 from 30 to 1,000 MHz; all values must lie below the stated limit curve.

text: For the frequency range 30-75 MHz, the electromagnetic broadband radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the limit E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m (F in MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth, as referenced in paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.
quote: Limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth 30-75 MHz
test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions at 30-75 MHz with a 120 kHz bandwidth and verify all readings are at or below 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.
merged: For the frequency range 400-1,000 MHz, the electromagnetic broadband radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the limit E = 63 dBµV/m for a 120 kHz bandwidth, as referenced in paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.

text: For the frequency range 75-400 MHz, the electromagnetic broadband radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the limit E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m (F in MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth, as referenced in paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.
test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions at 75-400 MHz with a 120 kHz bandwidth and verify all readings are at or below 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m.

text: For the frequency range 30-75 MHz, the electromagnetic narrowband radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the limit E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m (F in MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth, as referenced in paragraph 6.6.2.1.
quote: Limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth 30-75 MHz
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (e.g. LED driver/control electronics with oscillator or clock) generating narrowband emissions.
test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions at 30-75 MHz with a 120 kHz bandwidth and verify all readings are at or below 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.
merged: For the frequency range 75-400 MHz, the electromagnetic narrowband radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the limit E = 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m (F in MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth, as referenced in paragraph 6.6.2.1.

For the frequency range 400-1,000 MHz, the electromagnetic narrowband radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the limit E = 53 dBµV/m for a 120 kHz bandwidth, as referenced in paragraph 6.6.2.1.

text: For an ESA powered by LV, a 5 µH / 50 Ω AN as defined in Figure 1 shall be used.
quote: For an ESA powered by LV, a 5 µH / 50 Ω AN as defined in Figure 1 shall be used.
test_case: Inspect the test setup and report to confirm a 5 µH / 50 Ω AN per Figure 1 was used for the LV supply of the ESA.

text: For an ESA powered by LV, the AN(s) shall be mounted directly on the ground plane.
quote: The AN(s) shall be mounted directly on the ground plane.
test_case: Inspect the test setup to confirm the AN(s) are mounted directly on the ground plane.

text: For an ESA powered by LV, the grounding connection of the AN(s) shall be bonded to the ground plane.
quote: The grounding connection of the AN(s) shall be bonded to the ground plane.
test_case: Inspect the test setup to confirm the AN grounding connection is bonded to the ground plane.

text: For an ESA powered by LV, the measurement ports of AN(s) shall be terminated with a 50 Ω load.
quote: Measurement ports of AN(s) shall be terminated with a 50 Ω load.
test_case: Inspect the test setup to confirm AN measurement ports are terminated with 50 Ω loads.

text: The AN impedance ZPB (tolerance ± 20 %) in the measurement frequency range of 0,1 MHz to 100 MHz shall be as shown in Figure 2, measured between the terminals P and B with a 50 Ω load on the measurement port with terminals A and B short circuited.
quote: The AN impedance ZPB (tolerance ± 20 %) in the measurement frequency range of 0,1 MHz to 100 MHz is shown in Figure 2.
test_case: Review AN calibration data to confirm ZPB is within ± 20 % of the Figure 2 characteristic over 0,1-100 MHz.

text: The approval mark affixed to an ESA shall be laid out as shown in Model A (see paragraph 5.2. of this Regulation), with the dimension a = 6 mm min.
quote: Model A (See paragraph 5.2. of this Regulation) a = 6 mm min The above approval mark affixed to a vehicle or ESA
condition: Applies only if the lamp's LED driver/control electronics are approved as an ESA under UN R10 and carry an R10 approval mark.
test_case: Inspect the approval mark on the ESA and measure the dimension 'a'; pass if the layout matches Model A and a is at least 6 mm.

text: In the "50 km/h mode" vehicle immunity test with the brake pedal not depressed, there shall be no unexpected activation of brake and no unexpected activation of stop lights.
quote: Brake pedal not depressed Unexpected activation of brake and unexpected activation of stop lights
condition: Only if the lamp is assessed as part of a vehicle immunity test under Annex 6; Annex 6 applies only to vehicles.
test_case: During the vehicle 50 km/h mode immunity test per ISO 11451-2, monitor the stop lamps; pass if they never activate unexpectedly.

text: In the "50 km/h mode" vehicle immunity test with lighting (front light and rear light) ON, there shall be no lighting OFF.
quote: Dipped beams ON (manual mode) Lighting OFF (front light and rear light)
condition: Only if the lamp is assessed as part of a vehicle immunity test under Annex 6; Annex 6 applies only to vehicles.
test_case: During the vehicle 50 km/h mode immunity test, monitor the rear lights by video camera; pass if they never switch off.

text: In the "Brake mode" vehicle immunity test, with the brake pedal depressed to activate the brake function and the stop lights without any dynamic cycle, the stop lights shall not be inactivated during the mode.
quote: Brake pedal depressed to activate the brake function and the stop lights without any dynamic cycle. Stop lights inactivated during mode
condition: Only if the lamp is assessed as part of a vehicle immunity test under Annex 6; Annex 6 applies only to vehicles.
test_case: During the vehicle brake mode immunity test, monitor the stop lamps; pass if they stay lit throughout the exposure.

text: During the vehicle immunity test, all other equipment which can be switched ON by the driver or passengers shall be OFF.
quote: All other equipment which can be switched ON by the driver or passengers shall be OFF.
condition: Only if the lamp's EMC compliance is demonstrated through vehicle-level immunity testing rather than ESA testing
test_case: Check the vehicle test set-up record shows non-required driver-switchable equipment OFF.

text: For categories M, N, O, T, R and S vehicles, the reference point at which the field strength shall be established shall be defined according to ISO 11451-2.
quote: For categories M, N, O, T, R and S vehicles according to ISO 11451-2.
condition: Only if the lamp's EMC compliance is demonstrated through vehicle-level immunity testing rather than ESA testing
test_case: Confirm the test report defines the reference point per ISO 11451-2 for the M1 vehicle.

text: The vehicle shall be exposed to electromagnetic radiation in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges in vertical polarization.
quote: The vehicle shall be exposed to electromagnetic radiation in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges in vertical polarization.
condition: Only if the lamp's EMC compliance is demonstrated through vehicle-level immunity testing rather than ESA testing
test_case: Review the vehicle immunity test report and confirm exposure from 20 to 6,000 MHz in vertical polarization with no degradation of immunity related functions.

text: In the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range, the test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and vehicle manufacturer.
quote: AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range
condition: Only if the lamp's EMC compliance is demonstrated through vehicle-level immunity testing rather than ESA testing
test_case: Check the test report records AM 1 kHz at 80 % depth for 20-400 MHz.

text: In the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range, the test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and vehicle manufacturer.
quote: PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range
condition: Only if the lamp's EMC compliance is demonstrated through vehicle-level immunity testing rather than ESA testing
test_case: Check the test report records PM2 (Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs) for 2,700-3,100 MHz.

text: In the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges, the test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and vehicle manufacturer.
quote: PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges
condition: Only if the lamp's EMC compliance is demonstrated through vehicle-level immunity testing rather than ESA testing
test_case: Check the test report records PM3 (Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs) for 380-2,700 MHz and 3,100-6,000 MHz.

text: The substitution method according to ISO 11451-1 shall be used to establish the test field conditions.
quote: The substitution method according to ISO 11451-1, shall be used to establish the test field conditions.
condition: Only if the lamp's EMC compliance is demonstrated through vehicle-level immunity testing rather than ESA testing
test_case: Verify the test report states the field was established by the ISO 11451-1 substitution method.

text: If not otherwise stated in this Annex, the test to measure broadband electromagnetic emissions from ESAs shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
quote: If not otherwise stated in this Annex the test shall be performed according CISPR 25.
test_case: Review the test report to confirm the broadband radiated emission test was performed per CISPR 25.

text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
quote: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
test_case: Verify in the test report that all lamp functions were energised in normal operation mode at maximum load during the measurement.

text: For ESA other than involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", the test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
quote: For ESA other than involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" the test shall be performed according to the ALSE method
test_case: Confirm the test setup in the report follows the ALSE method of CISPR 25 Clause 6.4.

text: In the ambient measurement, the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1. of this Regulation, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.
quote: the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1. of this Regulation
test_case: Compare the ambient scan with the paragraph 6.5.2.1 limits and confirm a margin of at least 6 dB except for intentional narrowband transmissions.

text: To ensure that there is no extraneous noise or signal of a magnitude sufficient to affect materially the measurement, ambient measurements shall be taken before or after the main test.
quote: To ensure that there is no extraneous noise or signal of a magnitude sufficient to affect materially the measurement, measurements shall be taken before or after the main test.
test_case: Check the test report includes an ambient measurement taken before or after the main test.

text: If peak detectors are used, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied to the limits given in paragraphs 6.5. and 7.10. of this Regulation, which are for quasi-peak detectors.
quote: The limits given in paragraphs 6.5. and 7.10. of this Regulation are for quasi-peak detectors. If peak detectors are used a correction factor of 20 dB
test_case: Check that, where peak detection was used, the 20 dB correction factor was applied in the limit comparison.

text: When a spectrum analyser is used in the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz, the peak detector shall use an RBW at -3 dB of 100/120 kHz with a minimum scan time of 100 ms/MHz and the quasi-peak detector shall use an RBW at -6 dB of 120 kHz with a minimum scan time of 20 s/MHz, as given in Table 1.
quote: Table 1 Spectrum analyser parameters Frequency range MHz Peak detector Quasi-peak detector RBW at -3 dB Minimum scan time
test_case: Verify the spectrum analyser RBW and scan time settings recorded in the report match Table 1.

text: When a scanning receiver is used in the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz, the peak detector shall use a BW at -6 dB of 120 kHz, a maximum step size of 60 kHz and a minimum dwell time of 5 ms, and the quasi-peak detector shall use a BW at -6 dB of 120 kHz, a maximum step size of 60 kHz and a minimum dwell time of 1 s, as given in Table 2.
quote: Table 2 Scanning receiver parameters Frequency range MHz Peak detector Quasi-peak detector BW at -6 dB Maximum step size Minimum dwell time
test_case: Verify the scanning receiver bandwidth, step size and dwell time settings in the report match Table 2.

text: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video bandwidth shall be at least three times the resolution bandwidth (RBW).
quote: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video bandwidth shall be at least three times the resolution bandwidth (RBW).
test_case: Check the recorded VBW is at least 3 x RBW for peak measurements.

text: FFT-based measuring instruments shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time.
quote: FFT-based measuring instruments shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time.
condition: FFT-based measuring instrument used
test_case: Confirm from the instrument configuration that FFT measurement was gapless during the measurement time.

text: If using FFT-based instruments, the minimum measurement time shall be 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode) of the FFT instrument.
quote: If using FFT-based instruments, the minimum measurement time shall be 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode) of the FFT instrument.
condition: FFT-based measuring instrument used
test_case: Check the recorded measurement time is at least 1 s per FFT analysis band.

text: The phase centre of the antenna shall be in line with the centre of the longitudinal part of the wiring harnesses for frequencies up to 1,000 MHz.
quote: The phase centre of the antenna shall be in line with the centre of the longitudinal part of the wiring harnesses for frequencies up to 1,000 MHz.
test_case: Check the setup drawing or photos show the antenna phase centre aligned with the harness centre.

text: Unless otherwise specified, the configuration with the LV harness closer to the antenna shall be tested.
quote: Unless otherwise specified the configuration with the LV harness closer to the antenna shall be tested.
test_case: Verify from setup photos that the LV harness was placed closest to the antenna.

text: The test shall be performed at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz.
quote: The Technical Service shall perform the test at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz.
test_case: Verify the test frequencies cover 30 to 1,000 MHz at CISPR 12 intervals.

text: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation.
quote: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation.
test_case: For any exceedance, confirm the report documents an investigation distinguishing ESA emission from background radiation.

text: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarization) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.
quote: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarization) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading
test_case: Check the report takes the maximum reading of both polarizations per band as the characteristic reading and compares it with the limit.
merged: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarisation) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.

text: If not otherwise stated in Annex 8, the radiated narrowband electromagnetic emissions test of the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
quote: If not otherwise stated in this Annex the test shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (e.g. LED driver with microprocessor or oscillator) that can generate narrowband emissions
test_case: Review the test report to confirm the narrowband emission test was carried out to CISPR 25.

text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load, during the narrowband emission tests.
quote: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (e.g. LED driver with microprocessor or oscillator) that can generate narrowband emissions
test_case: Check the test plan and report: lamp functions are operated in normal mode with maximum load (all functions lit) during measurement.

text: The narrowband emission test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.
quote: The test shall be performed according to ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (e.g. LED driver with microprocessor or oscillator) that can generate narrowband emissions
test_case: Verify the test setup in the report matches the CISPR 25 paragraph 6.4 ALSE arrangement.

text: Where an open area test site (OATS) is used as an alternative to an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE), the OATS shall comply with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4.
quote: an open area test site (OATS) which complies with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4 may be used
condition: Narrowband emission testing is performed on an OATS instead of an ALSE
test_case: If OATS used, confirm site validation evidence to CISPR 16-1-4.

text: Ambient measurements shall be taken before or after the main test, and the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.
quote: the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (e.g. LED driver with microprocessor or oscillator) that can generate narrowband emissions
test_case: Check the ambient scan in the report is at least 6 dB below the paragraph 6.6.2.1 limits.

text: The narrowband emission limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (e.g. LED driver with microprocessor or oscillator) that can generate narrowband emissions
test_case: Measure narrowband emissions over 30-1,000 MHz; all readings below the paragraph 6.6.2.1 limits.
merged: The limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).

text: The narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
quote: Measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (e.g. LED driver with microprocessor or oscillator) that can generate narrowband emissions
test_case: Verify the receiver settings in the report use an average detector.

text: The narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver using the parameters defined in Tables 1 and 2.
quote: The measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver. The parameters to be used are defined in Tables 1 and 2.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (e.g. LED driver with microprocessor or oscillator) that can generate narrowband emissions
test_case: Check instrument type and settings in the report against Tables 1 and 2.
merged: The measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver using the parameters defined in Table 1 and Table 2.

text: When a spectrum analyser is used for the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz with an average detector, the RBW at -3 dB shall be 100/120 kHz and the minimum scan time shall be 100 ms/MHz, as given in Table 1.
quote: Frequency range MHz Average detector RBW at -3 dB Minimum scan time 30 to 1,000 100/120 kHz 100 ms/MHz
condition: Measurement performed with a spectrum analyser
test_case: Verify spectrum analyser RBW 100/120 kHz and scan time at least 100 ms/MHz in report.

text: When a scanning receiver is used for the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz with an average detector, the BW at -6 dB shall be 120 kHz, the maximum step size 60 kHz and the minimum dwell time 5 ms, as given in Table 2.
quote: Frequency range MHz Average detector BW at -6 dB Maximum step size Minimum dwell time 30 to 1,000 120 kHz 60 kHz 5 ms
condition: Measurement performed with a scanning receiver
test_case: Verify receiver BW 120 kHz, step ≤60 kHz and dwell ≥5 ms in report.

text: FFT-based measuring instruments shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time, with a minimum measurement time of 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode) of the FFT instrument.
quote: If using FFT-based instruments, the minimum measurement time shall be 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode) of the FFT instrument.
condition: Measurement performed with FFT-based instruments
test_case: Confirm FFT instrument recorded continuously with at least 1 s per analysis band.

text: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation including broadband radiation from the ESA.
quote: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (e.g. LED driver with microprocessor or oscillator) that can generate narrowband emissions
test_case: For any limit exceedance, check the report documents an investigation distinguishing ESA narrowband emission from background/broadband radiation.

text: The ESA may comply with the requirements of any combination of the absorber chamber test (ISO 11452-2), TEM cell testing (ISO 11452-3), bulk current injection testing (ISO 11452-4), stripline testing (ISO 11452-5) or reverberation chamber test (ISO 11452-11), at the manufacturer's discretion, only provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered.
quote: ESAs may comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion provided that these results in the full frequency range
test_case: Review the test plan and reports to confirm the selected methods together cover the full 20 to 6,000 MHz range.

text: The frequency range and general test conditions for the immunity tests of the ESA shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
quote: (Frequency range and general test conditions shall be based on ISO 11452-1).
test_case: Check the test report states that frequency range and general conditions follow ISO 11452-1.

text: The test conditions for the ESA shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
quote: The test conditions shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
test_case: Verify the test report documents test conditions per ISO 11452-1.

text: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
quote: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
test_case: Confirm during testing that the lamp functions are powered and operating normally.

text: The ESA under test shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
quote: It shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
test_case: Inspect the test set-up against the Annex 9 arrangement or the chosen ISO method.

text: Any extraneous equipment required to operate the ESA under test shall not be in place during the calibration phase.
quote: Any extraneous equipment required to operate the ESA under test shall not be in place during the calibration phase.
test_case: Check calibration records show no extraneous equipment was present.

text: No extraneous equipment shall be closer than 1 m from the reference point during calibration.
quote: No extraneous equipment shall be closer than 1 m from the reference point during calibration.
test_case: Verify calibration set-up has no equipment within 1 m of the reference point.

text: To ensure reproducible measurement results, the test signal generating equipment and its layout shall be to the same specification as that used during each appropriate calibration phase.
quote: the test signal generating equipment and its layout shall be to the same specification as that used during each appropriate calibration phase
test_case: Compare test and calibration equipment/layout records for identity.

text: If the ESA under test consists of more than one unit and the vehicle wiring harnesses are not available, the length between the electronic control unit and the AN shall be as defined in the standard.
quote: If these are not available, the length between the electronic control unit and the AN shall be as defined in the standard.
condition: ESA consists of more than one unit (e.g. separate LED driver/ECU) and vehicle harnesses are not available
test_case: Measure the ECU-to-AN cable length and compare with the standard.

text: Measurements on the ESA shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
quote: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
test_case: Verify the test report covers 20 to 6,000 MHz with ISO 11452-1 frequency steps.

text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.
quote: AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range
test_case: Check test generator settings: AM 1 kHz, 80 % depth over 20-400 MHz.

text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range.
quote: PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range
test_case: Check test generator settings: PM2, Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs over 2,700-3,100 MHz.

text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
quote: PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges
test_case: Check test generator settings: PM3, Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs over 380-2,700 and 3,100-6,000 MHz.

text: The frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
quote: Frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
test_case: Verify step size and dwell time in the report comply with ISO 11452-1.
merged: The frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11451-1.

text: The test shall be performed at the intervals specified in ISO 11452-1, throughout the frequency range 20 to 6,000 MHz, or, where accredited ISO 17025 laboratory data for the whole band are provided, at a reduced number of spot frequencies to confirm that the ESA meets the requirements of this Annex.
quote: The Technical Service shall perform the test at the intervals specified in ISO 11452-1, throughout the frequency range 20 to 6,000 MHz.
test_case: Review test frequencies against ISO 11452-1 intervals or the agreed spot frequencies with accredited full-band data.

text: If an ESA fails the tests defined in this Annex, it shall be verified as having failed under the relevant test conditions and not as a result of the generation of uncontrolled fields.
quote: If an ESA fails the tests defined in this Annex, it shall be verified as having failed under the relevant test conditions
test_case: On failure, check field monitoring confirms failure occurred under controlled test conditions.

text: When the absorber chamber test is used, the "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
quote: The "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
condition: Absorber chamber test (ISO 11452-2) selected
test_case: Verify the field calibration used the substitution method per ISO 11452-2.

text: When the absorber chamber test is used, the test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
quote: The test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
condition: Absorber chamber test (ISO 11452-2) selected
test_case: Check antenna orientation is vertical in the test report.

text: When TEM cell testing is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3.
quote: The test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3.
condition: TEM cell test selected
test_case: Verify the TEM cell test report references ISO 11452-3.
merged: When stripline testing is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-5.

text: When TEM cell testing is used, the method of maximum field coupling to the ESA or to the wiring harness inside the TEM-cell shall be chosen depending on the ESA to be tested.
quote: the Technical Service shall chose the method of maximum field coupling to the ESA or to the wiring harness inside the TEM-cell
condition: TEM cell test selected
test_case: Check the report documents the chosen coupling method (ESA or harness).

text: When bulk current injection testing is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with the BCI substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA, or with the BCI closed loop method and injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA, or alternatively with the ESA installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 with substitution method and injection probe at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
quote: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA;Or BCI test method with closed loop method
condition: Bulk current injection test selected
test_case: Verify BCI set-up method and probe distance (150 mm substitution or 900 mm closed loop) in the report.

text: When the reverberation chamber test is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11.
quote: The test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11.
condition: Reverberation chamber test selected
test_case: Verify the reverberation chamber test report references ISO 11452-11.

text: Unless otherwise specified, the reverberation chamber testing method shall be carried out using a test setup with ground plane.
quote: Unless otherwise specified, the reverberation chamber testing method shall be carried out using a test setup with ground plane.
condition: Reverberation chamber test selected
test_case: Inspect the reverberation chamber set-up for the presence of a ground plane.

text: The test method shall ensure the immunity of ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply and limit conducted transients from ESAs to the vehicle power supply.
quote: This test method shall ensure the immunity of ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply and limit conducted transients
condition: The lamp contains electronic content (LED driver/control electronics) making it an ESA not exempted as passive
test_case: Run the Annex 10 transient immunity and emission tests on the lamp and confirm both immunity and emission results are within the Regulation limits.

text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
quote: Apply the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines
condition: The lamp contains electronic content (LED driver/control electronics) making it an ESA not exempted as passive
test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b to the lamp supply and supply-connected lines and verify the required functional status per Table 3b.

text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines, except that ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to starting profile.
quote: Apply the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs
condition: The lamp is an ESA not exempted as passive and is not exclusively reserved for electric vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor
test_case: Apply the ISO 16750-2 starting profile to the lamp supply lines and verify the functional status class per Table 3a, unless the lamp is documented as EV-only.

text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by ESAs on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
quote: Measurement according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected
condition: The lamp contains electronic content (LED driver/control electronics) making it an ESA not exempted as passive
test_case: Measure conducted transient emissions of the lamp on its supply lines per ISO 7637-2 and confirm they are within the Regulation limits.

text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
quote: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2.
test_case: Inspect the mounting on the vehicle after vibration/normal-use conditions and verify the lamp retains its prescribed characteristics and position.

text: The lamps shall be fitted such that it is not possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
quote: In particular, it shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
test_case: Inspect the fixing design and attempt to displace the lamp by hand; verify no inadvertent misalignment is possible.

text: For all light-signalling devices, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road.
quote: the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road
test_case: Measure the reference axis orientation of the installed lamp relative to the road bearing plane; deviation within ±3°.

text: For all light-signalling devices other than side retro-reflectors and side-marker lamps, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.
quote: perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps and parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices
test_case: Measure the installed reference axis relative to the vehicle median longitudinal plane; deviation within ±3°.

text: For the orientation of the reference axis of light-signalling devices, in each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.
quote: In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.
test_case: Verify measured axis deviations in horizontal and vertical directions do not exceed ±3°.

text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting of the light-signalling devices laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
quote: In addition, any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
test_case: Compare the installation with the manufacturer's fitting instructions; all instructions followed.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2.
quote: the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface
test_case: Place the unladen vehicle on a flat horizontal surface and measure lamp height and orientation.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
quote: Be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp
test_case: Measure lateral positions of the left and right lamps from the median longitudinal plane based on exterior form; verify symmetry.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
quote: Be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp
test_case: Compare exterior geometry of left and right hand lamps; verify mirror symmetry (interior structure excluded).

text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
quote: Satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
test_case: Measure chromaticity of each function on left and right lamps; verify both meet the same colour requirements.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics; this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
quote: Have substantially identical photometric characteristics. This shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
test_case: Compare photometric measurements of left and right lamps for each function; verify substantially identical values.

text: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle.
quote: only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle
condition: Lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo
test_case: Inspect rear lamps for logos; verify at most two lateral or one central logo on the rear.

text: In case of lamps incorporating a logo, all logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.
quote: All logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.
condition: Lamp incorporates a logo
test_case: Inspect any logo in the lamp; verify it is a vehicle or body manufacturer logo.

text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical the requirements for lamps constituting a pair shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
quote: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical the above requirements shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
condition: Target vehicle has an asymmetrical external shape
test_case: Review the installation on the asymmetrical vehicle and verify pair symmetry provisions are met as far as possible.

text: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.
quote: provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled
test_case: For each grouped/combined function in the lamp, verify colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility and electrical connection requirements individually.

text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
quote: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
test_case: Measure photometry and colour of each function with all other functions of the lamp switched OFF; verify compliance.

text: When a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with it, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the rear position lamps are switched ON.
quote: the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON
condition: Rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with another function (e.g. stop lamp)
test_case: Switch ON the rear position lamp and the reciprocally incorporated function together and measure the colour of the other function; verify compliance.

text: Stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps shall not be reciprocally incorporated.
quote: Stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are not permitted to be reciprocally incorporated.
condition: Lamp integrates a direction-indicator function
test_case: Inspect the design to confirm the stop lamp does not share light-emitting parts with a direction indicator.

text: Where stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, any horizontal or vertical straight line passing through the projections of the apparent surfaces of these functions on a plane perpendicular to the reference axis shall not intersect more than two borderlines separating adjacent areas of different colour.
quote: shall not intersect more than two borderlines separating adjacent areas of different colour
condition: Lamp groups a stop lamp with a direction-indicator lamp
test_case: Draw horizontal and vertical lines across the projected apparent surfaces and count colour borderlines; maximum two.

text: Where stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, their apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis, based upon the areas bounded by the outline of their light emitting surfaces, shall not overlap.
quote: Their apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis, based upon the areas bounded by the outline of their light emitting surfaces, do not overlap.
condition: Lamp groups a stop lamp with a direction-indicator lamp
test_case: Project the apparent surfaces along the reference axis and verify no overlap.

text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis; these requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
quote: shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis
condition: A function's apparent surface is composed of two or more distinct parts
test_case: Measure the projected distinct parts; verify area ratio >= 60 % of the circumscribing quadrilateral or gap between facing edges <= 75 mm.

text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that either the projection of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of the two lamps or retro reflectors occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projections of the said apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of two lamps or two independent retro reflectors does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
quote: composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that
condition: Function is provided by two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro-reflectors
test_case: Measure projected apparent surfaces of the two lamps/retro-reflectors; verify >= 60 % area ratio or <= 75 mm gap.

text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
condition: Function is provided by an interdependent lamp system
test_case: Apply the paragraph 5.7.2.1 area/gap check to the interdependent lamp system.

text: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included into the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens these shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system.
quote: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included into the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens
test_case: Review the lamp classification; verify functions in a common body/lens are not declared as an interdependent lamp system.

text: Two lamps or an even number of lamps in the shape of a band or strip shall be placed symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, extending on both sides to within at least 0.4 m of the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, and are not less than 0.8 m long.
quote: shall be placed symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, extending on both sides to within at least 0.4 m
condition: Lamp function is in the shape of a band or strip counted as a single lamp
test_case: Measure band length (>= 0.8 m), symmetry and distance to outer edge (<= 0.4 m).

text: For lamps in the shape of a band or strip, the illumination of such a surface shall be provided by not less than two light sources placed as close as possible to the ends.
quote: the illumination of such a surface shall be provided by not less than two light sources placed as close as possible to the ends
condition: Lamp function is in the shape of a band or strip counted as a single lamp
test_case: Inspect the band lamp for at least two light sources located near its ends.

text: For lamps in the shape of a band or strip, the light-emitting surface may be constituted by a number of juxtaposed elements only on condition that these individual light-emitting surfaces, when projected on a transverse plane, fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
quote: the light-emitting surface may be constituted by a number of juxtaposed elements on condition that these individual light-emitting surfaces
condition: Band or strip lamp light-emitting surface made of juxtaposed elements
test_case: Project the juxtaposed elements on a transverse plane and apply the 5.7.2.1 area/gap criteria.

text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
quote: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front
test_case: Verify on the vehicle that no red light from the rear lamp is visible from the front, per paragraph 5.10.4.

text: The maximum height above the ground of a lamp shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
quote: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface
test_case: Measure the highest and lowest points of each function's apparent surface above ground and compare to the height limits.

text: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground shall be measured from the H plane.
quote: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground, shall be measured from the H plane.
test_case: Where reduced vertical visibility angles are claimed, measure the lamp height from the H plane and verify eligibility.

text: The position, as regards width, shall be determined from that edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is the furthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle when referred to the overall width, and from the inner edges of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis when referred to the distance between lamps.
quote: The position, as regards width, will be determined from that edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis
test_case: Measure the lateral position of each lamp from the outermost edge (overall width) and inner edges (distance between lamps) of the apparent surface along the reference axis and check against the individual specifications.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
quote: the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON
test_case: Operate each lamp function continuously and verify intensity, colour and apparent surface remain constant while switched ON.

text: Where the photometric characteristics of any lamp vary in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, any variation in the photometric characteristics shall be in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
quote: provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned
condition: Lamp photometric characteristics vary with ambient light, other lamps or another lighting function (e.g. reciprocally incorporated position/stop lamp, variable intensity)
test_case: Measure photometry in each varying operating state and confirm all values remain within the device approval provisions.

text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
quote: there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1
test_case: Observe from Zone 1 in a transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle (Annex 4) and confirm no direct view of the red lamps' apparent surfaces.

text: In case of doubt, the requirement of paragraph 5.10.4.1. shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
quote: is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable
test_case: Measure the red light intensity emitted towards the front, including vehicle body influence, and confirm it is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp.

text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist
test_case: Operate the lighting switch on the vehicle and verify front/rear position, marker and registration plate lamps switch ON and OFF together.

text: The requirement of paragraph 5.11. shall not apply while front and rear position lamps are switched ON as parking lamps, side-marker lamps flash in conjunction with direction indicators, daytime running lamps are switched ON, or front position lamps function is substituted under the provisions of paragraph 5.12.1.
quote: This requirement does not apply while one or more of the following conditions exist: (a) Front and rear position lamps
test_case: Check that any non-simultaneous switching of the rear position lamps occurs only under the listed exception conditions.

text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
quote: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
condition: Lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system (e.g. split body/tailgate)
test_case: Switch the function ON and OFF and verify all light sources of the interdependent lamp system change state simultaneously.

text: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use.
quote: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps
test_case: Inspect the installation and verify the rear position, stop, reversing lamps and retro-reflector are not concealable.

text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
quote: The colours of the light emitted by the lamps are the following: ... Reversing lamp: White
test_case: Measure chromaticity of the reversing lamp and confirm it is within the white boundaries.

text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
quote: The colours of the light emitted by the lamps are the following: ... Stop lamp: Red
test_case: Measure chromaticity of the stop lamp and confirm it is within the red boundaries.

text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
