quote: The colours of the light emitted by the lamps are the following: ... Rear position lamp: Red
test_case: Measure chromaticity of the rear position lamp and confirm it is within the red boundaries.

text: The colour of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
quote: Rear retro-reflector, non- triangular: Red
test_case: Measure the colour of the retro-reflected light and confirm it is red.

text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
quote: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
test_case: Count installed rear position, stop, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors and compare with the individual specifications.

text: Any lamp may be installed on movable components only provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
quote: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
condition: Lamp (or part of it) is installed on a movable component such as a tailgate or boot lid
test_case: For lamps on movable components, verify compliance with paragraphs 5.18 to 5.20.

text: Rear position lamps and rear retro-reflectors, triangular as well as non-triangular, may be installed on movable components only if at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
quote: If at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements
condition: Rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector is installed on a movable component
test_case: Place the movable component in each fixed position and verify position, geometric visibility, colour and photometry of the lamps.

text: In the case where the rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector functions are obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D", only one of the lamps needs to meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable components.
quote: only one of the lamps needs to meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions
condition: Function obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D" with one on a movable component
test_case: With the movable component in all fixed positions, verify at least one "D" lamp meets position, visibility and photometric requirements.

text: Rear position lamps and rear retro-reflectors may be installed on movable components where additional lamps for the above functions are fitted and are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
quote: provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component
condition: Additional lamps are used to compensate for lamps on a movable component in open positions
test_case: Open the movable component to each fixed open position and verify the additional lamps switch ON and meet position, visibility and photometric requirements.

text: Should the interdependent lamp system for rear position lamps be partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
quote: the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements
condition: Rear position function obtained by an interdependent lamp system split between fixed and movable components
test_case: At all fixed positions of the movable component, verify the specified interdependent lamp(s) meet position, outward visibility, colour and photometric requirements.

text: Should the complete interdependent lamp system for rear position lamps be mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied, and any additional lamps switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
quote: Should the complete interdependent lamp system be mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied.
condition: Rear position function obtained by an interdependent lamp system entirely on a movable component
test_case: Verify paragraph 5.18.1 compliance at all fixed positions and, where used, the additional lamps' compliance in open positions.

text: Should the interdependent lamp system be partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, the inwards geometric visibility requirement(s) shall be deemed to be satisfied if the interdependent lamp(s) still conform(s) to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the approval of the device, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
quote: The inwards geometric visibility requirement(s) is(are) deemed to be satisfied if this(these) interdependent lamp(s) still conform(s) to the photometric values
condition: Rear position function obtained by an interdependent lamp system split between fixed and movable components
test_case: Measure photometry in the field of light distribution at all fixed positions of the movable component and confirm conformity.

text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
quote: the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users
condition: Lamp is installed on a movable component
test_case: With the movable component in non-normal positions, assess that the lamps do not cause undue discomfort (e.g. glare) to road users.

text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
quote: the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation
condition: Lamp is installed on a movable component
test_case: Cycle the movable component and verify the lamp returns to the manufacturer-specified position each time.

text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of rear position lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
quote: shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it
condition: A movable component (e.g. tailgate/boot lid) can obscure the lamp in an open fixed position
test_case: Place each movable component in each fixed position and measure that no more than 50 % of the apparent surface of rear position lamps and retro-reflectors is hidden.

text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21. is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps and retro-reflectors shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
quote: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON
condition: Apparent surface more than 50 % hidden by a movable component in a fixed open position
test_case: With the movable component open, verify additional compliant lamps are switched ON when more than 50 % of the apparent surface is hidden.

text: Where more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road (not applicable to retro-reflectors).
quote: A notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned
condition: Lamp installed on a movable component (tailgate/boot lid) with more than 50 per cent of apparent surface hideable
test_case: Inspect vehicle documentation/labels for the required user notice when the lamp is on a movable component.

text: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp even bearing an approval mark is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
quote: a lamp even bearing an approval mark is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation
test_case: Verify on the vehicle that each lamp function operates without further action than installation of light source and/or fuse.

text: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.
quote: shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source(s) approved to UN R37
test_case: Replace the light source on the vehicle using only vehicle-provided tools and confirm correct replacement without expert assistance.

text: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement of the light source.
quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement.
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source(s) approved to UN R37
test_case: Check owner documentation contains a detailed light source replacement procedure.

text: In the case where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37, this light source shall be replaceable as required in paragraph 5.23.
quote: In the case where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37
condition: Light source module includes a holder for an R37 replaceable light source
test_case: Verify the R37 light source in the module can be replaced per paragraph 5.23.

text: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed only provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.
quote: provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate
condition: A temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function is implemented
test_case: Simulate rear position lamp failure and verify the replacement function's colour, intensity and position, and that the replacement device keeps its original function.

text: During temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
quote: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
condition: A temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function is implemented
test_case: Simulate failure and confirm the dashboard tell-tale indicates temporary replacement.

text: Rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control are allowed only provided that the intensity of all such lamps, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
quote: The intensity of the all lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
condition: Rear position lamp R2 and/or stop lamp S2 with variable luminous intensity control
test_case: Measure intensities of variable-intensity lamps across the control range and confirm they vary together proportionally.

text: For rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, in the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
quote: In the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
condition: Rear position lamp R2 and/or stop lamp S2 with variable luminous intensity control
test_case: Measure stop/position intensity ratio during transitions and confirm the prescribed ratio is maintained.

text: For variable luminous intensity rear position lamps R2 and stop lamps S2, increase and decrease of the luminous intensity shall be in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations and only in relation to ambient lighting, fog, snowfall, rain, spray, dust clouds or contamination of the light emitting surface.
quote: Increase and decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed in relation to the following conditions
condition: Variable luminous intensity control (R2/S2) responding to environmental conditions
test_case: Review control strategy and measure intensities to confirm variation stays within regulation limits and is triggered only by listed conditions.

text: For variable luminous intensity rear position lamps R2 and stop lamps S2, a decrease of the luminous intensity due to traffic conditions, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed only as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m; an intensity decrease already activated may remain active as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h.
quote: a decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h
condition: Variable luminous intensity control (R2/S2) responding to traffic conditions
test_case: Test vehicle at varying speeds/following distances and confirm decrease activation and deactivation thresholds.

text: No sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition of the variable luminous intensity lamps.
quote: No sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.
condition: Variable luminous intensity control (R2/S2) fitted
test_case: Record intensity over time during transitions and confirm no sharp step changes.

text: For vehicles of M and N categories, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, the voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
quote: shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved
condition: Device approved with special power supply, secondary operating mode or applicant-requested voltage and not exempted by paragraph 5.27.3.
test_case: Measure terminal voltage at constant vehicle voltage operating condition and compare with the approved voltage.

text: For vehicles of M and N categories, in all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
quote: the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V
condition: Device does not include electronic light source control gear, integral variable intensity control, or only R128 light sources (paragraph 5.27.3.)
test_case: Measure terminal voltage under constant voltage operating condition and confirm it is not more than 3 per cent above 13.5 V (12 V system).

text: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to devices which include an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
quote: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to devices which include: - an electronic light source control gear
condition: Presence of electronic light source control gear, integral variable intensity control or only R128 light sources
test_case: Review device design/approval documentation to determine whether the voltage exemption applies.

text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity, except obstacles already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
quote: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface
test_case: Check on the installed lamp that no vehicle part obstructs light within the geometric visibility angles.

text: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
quote: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
test_case: Verify geometric visibility measurement method uses parallel-shifted observation directions when measuring close to the lamp.

text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
quote: proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed
condition: Part of the apparent surface hidden by other vehicle parts when installed
test_case: Perform photometric measurement with the obstructing parts simulated and confirm compliance with device photometric values.

text: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5° (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.) the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5° below the horizontal.
quote: the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5º below the horizontal
condition: Lamp mounted at less than 750 mm above the ground
test_case: Confirm mounting height below 750 mm before applying the reduced photometric field to 5° below horizontal.

text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
quote: In the case of an interdependent lamp system the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
condition: Lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system (e.g. split body/tailgate)
test_case: Operate all interdependent lamps together and verify geometric visibility angles.

text: A LED module does not need to be replaceable only if so stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
quote: A LED module does not need to be replaceable, if so stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
condition: Lamp uses LED module(s)
test_case: Check the component approval communication sheet states the LED module is non-replaceable.

text: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
quote: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs
test_case: Verify approval marks/certificates (R148 for position, stop, reversing; R150 for retro-reflector) are present for each function.

text: In case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
quote: in case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148
condition: Lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo
test_case: Check R148 approval covers the lamp including the logo.

text: Lamps installed on a vehicle approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only; this does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.
quote: shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only
condition: Lamp approved for replaceable light source categories (R37/R99/R128)
test_case: Inspect fitted light sources for approval marks of the approved categories.

text: The use of lamps approved for and equipped with LED substitute light source(s) is allowed exclusively in the case where the statement indicated in paragraph 3.2.8. is present and positive, and the presence of the marking on the lamps related to the use of LED substitute light source(s) shall be checked.
quote: the presence of the marking on the lamps related to the use of LED substitute light source(s) shall be checked
condition: Lamp approved for and equipped with LED substitute light source(s)
test_case: Check application statement 3.2.8 is positive and the LED substitute marking is present on the lamp.

text: The reversing lamp shall be present (mandatory) on motor vehicles.
quote: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4.
test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle installation and confirm that at least one reversing lamp is fitted.

text: On motor vehicles of category M1, one reversing lamp device shall be mandatory and a second device optional.
quote: One device mandatory and a second device optional on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.
test_case: Count the reversing lamps fitted on the M1 vehicle and confirm there are one or two.

text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
quote: These devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series
test_case: Check that the lamp carries a valid R23 or R148 approval mark for the reversing function.

text: In height, the reversing lamp shall be not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
quote: In height: not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
test_case: Measure the height of the apparent surface above the ground on the unladen vehicle and confirm it is within 250-1,200 mm.

text: In length, the reversing lamp shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
quote: In length: at the rear of the vehicle
test_case: Inspect the vehicle and confirm that the reversing lamp is mounted at the rear.

text: For reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, and β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device.
quote: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device
condition: Only one reversing lamp fitted on the vehicle
test_case: Verify the apparent surface is unobstructed over 15° up/5° down and 45° left/right using geometric visibility measurement.

text: For reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, and β = 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.
quote: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.
condition: Two reversing lamps fitted on the vehicle
test_case: Verify each lamp's apparent surface is unobstructed over 15° up/5° down, 45° outwards and 30° inwards.

text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
quote: Orientation Rearwards
test_case: Inspect the installation and confirm that the reference axis points rearwards.

text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
quote: They shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting
test_case: Perform a functional test: the lamp lights only with reverse gear engaged and the propulsion system operable.

text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in a position where operation of the propulsion system is possible.
quote: It shall not switch ON or remain ON if either of the above conditions is not satisfied.
test_case: Disengage reverse gear or switch off the propulsion system and confirm that the lamp goes off and cannot be switched on.

text: For the reversing lamp, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
quote: Tell-tale optional, however a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
condition: Component regulation (R23/R148) requires a failure tell-tale for the lamp's design
test_case: Review the R148 approval documentation; if failure indication is required, simulate a failure and verify the tell-tale activates.
merged: For stop lamps, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.

text: Stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
quote: Devices of S1 or S2 categories: mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle installation and confirm S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices are fitted.

text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
quote: The devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series
test_case: Check the approval mark on the stop lamp for a valid UN R7 (02+ series) or UN R148 (00+ series) approval.

text: Two S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be installed on all categories of vehicles.
quote: Two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.
test_case: Count the S1/S2 stop lamp devices on the vehicle; pass if exactly two are installed.

text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, for S1 or S2 categories devices, that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm
test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

text: For S1 or S2 categories devices, the height above the ground shall be not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: Above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork
test_case: Measure the stop lamp apparent surface height above ground per paragraph 5.8.1; pass if within 350 mm to 1,500 mm (or 2,100 mm where justified by bodywork).

text: For S1 or S2 categories devices, the position in length shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: at the rear of the vehicle.
test_case: Inspect vehicle installation; pass if the stop lamps are located at the rear of the vehicle.

text: For S1 or S2 categories devices, the horizontal angle of geometric visibility shall be 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
quote: Horizontal angle: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
test_case: Verify unobstructed visibility of the stop lamp apparent surface over 45° left and right; pass if visible across the full range.

text: For S1 or S2 categories devices, the vertical angle of geometric visibility shall be 15° above and below the horizontal.
quote: Vertical angle: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 15° above and below the horizontal.
test_case: Verify unobstructed visibility of the stop lamp apparent surface over 15° above and below horizontal.

text: For the stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
quote: for the stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20°
condition: Stop lamp mounted below 750 mm
test_case: If mounting height < 750 mm, verify inward visibility under the H plane of at least 20°.

text: For S1 or S2 categories devices, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
quote: Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°
condition: Stop lamp mounted below 750 mm
test_case: If mounting height < 750 mm, verify downward visibility of at least 5°.

text: The orientation of the stop lamps shall be towards the rear of the vehicle.
quote: Orientation Towards the rear of the vehicle.
test_case: Inspect installation; pass if the stop lamp reference axis points towards the rear of the vehicle.

text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
quote: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
test_case: Apply the braking signal and observe; pass if all stop lamps switch ON simultaneously.

text: Rear position lamps of R or R1 or R2 categories shall be present (mandatory).
quote: Presence Devices of R or R1 or R2 categories: Mandatory
test_case: Inspect the vehicle; pass if rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 are fitted.

text: The number of rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
quote: Two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series
test_case: Check vehicle has two rear position lamps bearing a valid R7 (02+) or R148 (00+) approval mark.

text: For the rear position lamps, that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
quote: that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm
test_case: Measure lateral distance from outermost point of rear position lamp apparent surface to vehicle outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

text: The rear position lamps shall be positioned in height above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
quote: In height: above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible
test_case: Measure rear position lamp apparent surface height per paragraph 5.8.1; pass if within 350–1,500 mm (or 2,100 mm where justified).

text: The rear position lamps shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
quote: In length: The rear of the vehicle.
test_case: Inspect installation; pass if rear position lamps are at the rear of the vehicle.

text: The horizontal angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamps shall be 45° inwards and 80° outwards.
quote: Horizontal angle: 45° inwards and 80° outwards.
test_case: Verify unobstructed visibility of rear position lamp apparent surface over 45° inwards and 80° outwards.

text: The vertical angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamps shall be 15° above and below the horizontal.
quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal.
test_case: Verify unobstructed visibility of rear position lamp over 15° above and below horizontal.

text: For the rear position lamps, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
quote: where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane
condition: Rear position lamp mounted below 750 mm
test_case: If mounting height < 750 mm, verify inward visibility under the H plane of at least 20°.
merged: For the rear position lamps, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the horizontal angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamps shall be 45° outwards to 45° inwards, where for a lamp mounted below 750 mm the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
quote: only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, Horizontal angle: 45° outwards to 45° inwards.
condition: Manufacturer uses the alternative visibility and a rear side-marker lamp is installed
test_case: If alternative applied, confirm rear side-marker lamp is fitted and verify visibility 45° outwards to 45° inwards.

text: When the alternative geometric visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2. is applied, to be considered visible the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light being excluded.
quote: To be considered visible, the lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres.
condition: Manufacturer uses the alternative visibility and a rear side-marker lamp is installed
test_case: Measure the unobstructed projected apparent surface at the limit angles, excluding non-transmitting retro-reflector area; pass if ≥ 12.5 cm².

text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the vertical angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamps shall be 15° above and below the horizontal, where for a lamp mounted below 750 mm the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm
condition: Manufacturer uses the alternative visibility and a rear side-marker lamp is installed
test_case: If alternative applied, verify vertical visibility 15° above and below horizontal (5° downward if below 750 mm).

text: The orientation of the rear position lamps shall be rearwards.
quote: Orientation Rearwards.
test_case: Inspect installation; pass if the rear position lamp reference axis points rearwards.

text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamps shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11.
quote: Electrical connections In accordance with paragraph 5.11.
test_case: Check the wiring against paragraph 5.11 (switching together with front position lamps etc.); pass if compliant.

text: A closed-circuit tell-tale shall be provided for the rear position lamps.
quote: Tell-tale. Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory.
test_case: Switch on the rear position lamps on the vehicle and check that the closed-circuit tell-tale lights.

text: The closed-circuit tell-tale of the rear position lamps shall be combined with that of the front position lamps; this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
quote: It shall be combined with that of the front position lamps. This requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
test_case: Check that one combined tell-tale indicates both front and rear position lamps (except when DRL are ON).

text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamps is mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
quote: However, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
condition: Failure tell-tale required by the component Regulation (e.g. electronic failure monitoring).
test_case: Simulate a rear position lamp failure and verify that the failure tell-tale activates where required by the component Regulation.

text: In all cases, the distance between the rear fog-lamp and each stop-lamp shall be greater than 100 mm.
quote: In all cases, the distance between the rear fog-lamp and each stop-lamp shall be greater than 100 mm.
condition: Vehicle is fitted with a rear fog lamp (not part of this lamp).
test_case: Measure on the vehicle the distance between the rear fog lamp and each stop lamp; pass if greater than 100 mm.

text: Where the functioning of the parking lamp is performed by simultaneously switching ON the front and rear position lamps on the same side of the vehicle, the lamps shall meet the requirements of front or rear position lamps.
quote: The functioning of this lamp may also be performed by simultaneously switching ON the front and rear position lamps on the same side of the vehicle.
condition: Parking function performed by the position lamps.
test_case: Activate parking function and verify the front and rear position lamps on that side light and are approved position lamps.

text: The position of an end-outline marker lamp in relation to the corresponding position lamp shall be such that the distance between the projections on a transverse vertical plane of the nearest points of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the respective reference axes is not less than 200 mm.
quote: The position of an end-outline marker lamp in relation to corresponding position lamp shall be such that the distance between the projections
condition: Vehicle is fitted with end-outline marker lamps (vehicle width over 1.80 m).
test_case: Measure the projected distance between nearest apparent-surface points of end-outline marker and rear position lamp; pass if at least 200 mm.

text: Rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be present on motor vehicles.
quote: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles.
test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle rear for the presence of non-triangular rear retro-reflectors.

text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
quote: Two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3
test_case: Check that two rear retro-reflectors are fitted and bear Class IA or IB approval marks under UN R3 (02+) or UN R150 (00+).

text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4.) shall not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
quote: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4. below), are permitted provided they do not impair the effectiveness
condition: Additional retro-reflecting devices or materials are fitted.
test_case: Inspect any additional retro-reflecting devices and verify they do not impair the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.

text: In width, that point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
quote: In width: that point on the illuminating surface which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm
test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost illuminating-surface point to the vehicle outer edge; pass if not more than 400 mm.

text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear retro-reflectors in the direction of the reference axes shall have no special requirement.
quote: The distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: have no special requirement
test_case: Confirm vehicle category is M1; no inner-edge separation check required.

text: In height, the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively).
quote: In height: Above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s)
test_case: Measure mounting height of the retro-reflector above ground on the unladen vehicle; pass if 250 mm to 900 mm (1,200 mm if grouped, 1,500 mm if bodywork prevents).

text: In length, the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
quote: In length: at the rear of the vehicle.
test_case: Inspect that the retro-reflector is located at the rear of the vehicle.

text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be a horizontal angle of 30° inwards and outwards.
quote: Geometric visibility Horizontal angle: 30° inwards and outwards.
test_case: Verify on the vehicle or CAD that the illuminating surface is unobstructed over 30° inwards and outwards.

text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be a vertical angle of 10° above and below horizontal; however, where the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
quote: Vertical angle: 10° above and below horizontal. However, where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm
test_case: Verify unobstructed visibility 10° up and 10° down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm).

text: The orientation of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be rearwards.
quote: Orientation Rearwards.
test_case: Check that the retro-reflector reference axis points rearwards on the vehicle.

text: Rear retro-reflectors, triangular, shall not be fitted on motor vehicles.
quote: Presence Mandatory on trailers. Prohibited on motor vehicles.
test_case: Inspect the retro-reflector shape; pass if it is not triangular.

text: When daytime running lamps are switched ON, the rear position lamps shall be switched ON.
quote: When daytime running lamps are switched ON, the rear position lamps shall be switched ON.
test_case: On the vehicle, activate the daytime running lamps and verify that the rear position lamps switch ON.

text: The rear position lamps may be switched OFF when the daytime running lamps are switched ON only as long as the ambient light conditions outside vehicle are above 7,000 lux (measured according to the requirements of Annex 13).
quote: may remain switched OFF as long as the ambient light conditions outside vehicle are above 7,000 lux (measured according to the requirements of Annex 13).
condition: Vehicle wiring switches the rear position lamps OFF while the daytime running lamps are ON under high ambient light
test_case: With DRL ON, vary the ambient light measured per Annex 13 and verify the rear position lamps are OFF only above 7,000 lux and switch ON at or below it.

text: The emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop or direction-indicator lamps fitted as described in paragraph 6.23.7.
quote: The emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop or direction-indicator lamps fitted
condition: Whether the stop lamps of this product are used to give the emergency stop signal (instead of the direction-indicator lamps)
test_case: Trigger the emergency braking logic signal on the vehicle and verify that all stop lamps operate simultaneously.

text: The number of lamps of the emergency stop signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.2. or 6.7.2.
quote: Number As specified in paragraph 6.5.2. or 6.7.2.
condition: Whether the stop lamps of this product are used to give the emergency stop signal
test_case: Count the stop lamps used for the emergency stop signal and compare with paragraph 6.7.2.
merged: The position of the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.4. or 6.7.4.

text: The arrangement of the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.3. or 6.7.3.
quote: Arrangement As specified in paragraph 6.5.3. or 6.7.3.
condition: Whether the stop lamps of this product are used to give the emergency stop signal
test_case: Inspect the installed stop lamp arrangement against paragraph 6.7.3.
merged: The orientation of the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.6. or 6.7.6.

text: The geometric visibility of the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.5. or 6.7.5.
quote: Geometric visibility As specified in paragraph 6.5.5. or 6.7.5.
condition: Whether the stop lamps of this product are used to give the emergency stop signal
test_case: Verify the installed stop lamp geometric visibility angles against paragraph 6.7.5.

text: All the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
quote: All the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
condition: Whether the stop lamps of this product are used to give the emergency stop signal
test_case: Activate the emergency stop signal and measure flash frequency and phase; pass if in phase and 3.0-5.0 Hz.

text: If any of the lamps of the emergency stop signal to the rear of the vehicle use filament light sources the frequency shall be 4.0 +0.0/-1.0 Hz.
quote: if any of the lamps of the emergency stop signal to the rear of the vehicle use filament light sources the frequency shall be
condition: Whether any rear lamp of the emergency stop signal uses filament light sources (product stated as LED)
test_case: Where filament light sources are used, measure the flash frequency; pass if between 3.0 and 4.0 Hz.

text: The emergency stop signal shall operate independently of other lamps.
quote: The emergency stop signal shall operate independently of other lamps.
condition: Whether the stop lamps of this product are used to give the emergency stop signal
test_case: Activate the emergency stop signal with other lamps on and off and verify it operates independently.

text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON and OFF automatically.
quote: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON and OFF automatically.
condition: Whether the stop lamps of this product are used to give the emergency stop signal
test_case: Verify by vehicle test that the signal activates and deactivates without manual control.

text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
quote: shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal
condition: Whether the stop lamps of this product are used to give the emergency stop signal
test_case: Perform emergency braking below and above 50 km/h; pass if the signal is activated only above 50 km/h with the logic signal present.

text: The emergency stop signal shall be automatically switched OFF if the emergency braking logic signal as defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H is no longer provided or if the hazard warning signal is activated.
quote: shall be automatically switched OFF if the emergency braking logic signal as defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H is no longer provided
condition: Whether the stop lamps of this product are used to give the emergency stop signal
test_case: Remove the logic signal or activate the hazard warning signal during operation; pass if the emergency stop signal switches OFF automatically.

text: Except as provided in paragraph 6.23.9.2., if a motor vehicle is equipped to tow a trailer, the control of the emergency stop signal on the motor vehicle shall also be capable of operating the emergency stop signal on the trailer, and when electrically connected to a trailer the operating frequency for the combination shall be limited to the frequency specified in paragraph 6.23.7.1.1.
quote: the control of the emergency stop signal on the motor vehicle shall also be capable of operating the emergency stop signal on the trailer
condition: Whether the vehicle is equipped to tow a trailer and the stop lamps give the emergency stop signal
test_case: With a trailer connected, activate the emergency stop signal and verify trailer operation and frequency limitation.

text: The exterior courtesy lamp(s) shall not flash.
quote: The exterior courtesy lamp(s) shall not flash.
condition: Whether the rear position lamps of this product are switched ON as exterior courtesy lamps
test_case: Activate the courtesy function and verify the rear position lamps are steady-burning.

text: Reversing lamps shall not be switched ON as exterior courtesy lamp(s); only approved lamps emitting white light other than main beam headlamps, daytime running lamps and reversing lamps, and rear position lamps, may be switched ON as exterior courtesy lamp(s).
quote: Approved lamps emitting white light with the exception of main beam head lamps, daytime running lamps and reversing lamps may be switched ON
condition: Whether the vehicle uses lamps of this product as exterior courtesy lamps
test_case: Review the courtesy lamp activation logic; pass if the reversing lamp is not activated as exterior courtesy lamp.

text: The answer-back signal shall only operate under the park condition of a vehicle.
quote: The answer-back signal shall only operate under the park condition of a vehicle.
condition: The lamp is used for an answer-back signal (not stated).
test_case: Try to activate the answer-back signal outside the park condition and confirm it does not operate.

text: If the answer-back signal flashes, the frequency shall not exceed 2.0 Hz.
quote: If the answer-back signal flashes, the frequency shall not exceed 2.0 Hz.
condition: The lamp is used for a flashing answer-back signal (not stated).
test_case: Measure the flash frequency of the answer-back signal and confirm it is ≤ 2.0 Hz.

text: If the lamp is used for the answer-back signal, the answer-back signal shall be provided by approved lighting and light-signalling devices and exterior courtesy lamps where in all these cases the maximum luminous intensity per lamp does not exceed 700 cd on or above the HH line.
quote: The answer-back signal shall be provided by approved lighting and light-signalling devices and exterior courtesy lamps where in all these cases, the maximum luminous intensity per lamp does not exceed 700 cd
condition: The rear position or reversing lamp is used by the vehicle for an answer-back signal (not stated).
test_case: Review the test report and confirm the lamp is approved and its maximum intensity on or above the HH line in answer-back mode is ≤ 700 cd.

text: Front fog lamps, rear fog lamps and stop lamps shall not be used for the answer-back signal.
quote: However, front fog lamps, rear fog lamps and stop lamps are not permitted to be used.
condition: The vehicle provides an answer-back signal (not stated).
test_case: Trigger the answer-back signal on the vehicle and confirm the stop lamp does not light.

text: The duration of the optical indication of the answer-back signal shall not exceed 3 seconds, irrespective of whether it contains flashes, variations of intensity or variations in apparent surface.
quote: The duration of the optical indication of the answer-back signal shall not exceed 3 seconds.
condition: The lamp is used for an answer-back signal (not stated).
test_case: Time the answer-back signal from its start to its end and confirm it is ≤ 3 s.

text: If provided, the reversing projections shall be switched ON only when the reversing lamp(s) is/are switched ON.
quote: If provided, the reversing projections shall be switched ON only when the reversing lamp(s) is/are switched ON.
condition: The vehicle is fitted with reversing projectors (not stated).
test_case: With the reversing lamps OFF, confirm the reversing projection cannot be switched ON.

text: In the case where the non-textured outer lens is excluded and "7b" is the apparent surface according to paragraph 2.10.2., F1 shall not be transparent to F2 for the reciprocal incorporation of two functions.
quote: In the case where the non‑textured outer lens is excluded, "7b" is the apparent surface according to paragraph 2.10.2. and F1 shall not be transparent to F2
condition: Whether the rear position and stop lamps (or other functions) are reciprocally incorporated with this configuration
test_case: Inspect the lamp construction to confirm the F1 function area is not transparent to light of the F2 function.

text: For verifying the visibility of a red lamp to the front and of a white lamp to the rear (paragraph 5.10.4.), the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground.
quote: the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer are bounded: - In height, by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground
test_case: Check from observer positions between 1 m and 2.2 m above ground in zone 1 (front) that no red light from the rear lamp is directly visible.

text: For verifying the visibility of a red lamp to the front and of a white lamp to the rear (paragraph 5.10.4.), the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in width by two vertical planes which, forming to the front and to the rear respectively an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, pass through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width.
quote: In width, by two vertical planes which, forming to the front and to the rear respectively an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane
test_case: Construct the 15° outward planes through the overall-width contact points and verify no red light from the rear lamp is directly visible within zone 1.

text: If there are several points of contact of the vertical planes delimiting the vehicle's overall width, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane and the rearmost to the rearward plane.
quote: if there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane and the rearmost to the rearward plane
test_case: Verify on the vehicle drawing that the foremost contact point is used for the forward zone plane and the rearmost for the rearward zone plane.

text: The values measured for the distances of the position of lamps shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
quote: The values measured for the distances shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
test_case: Compare measured mounting distances of rear position, stop, reversing lamps and retro-reflectors with their individual specifications; pass if all within limits.

text: The position of lamps, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6. of this Regulation, in width, in height and in length shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation.
quote: The position of lamps, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6. of this Regulation, in width, in height and in length shall be checked
test_case: Measure lamp width, height and length positions on the vehicle per paragraphs 2.10.2.-2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4.; pass if measurements are recorded per those methods.

text: The values measured for the angles of geometric visibility shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
quote: The values measured for the angles shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled except that the limits
test_case: Compare measured visibility angles with each lamp's individual specification allowing ±3°; pass if within limits.

text: The angles of geometric visibility shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation.
quote: The angles of geometric visibility shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation.
test_case: Check geometric visibility angles of each lamp per paragraph 2.10.7.; pass if the check is performed per that method.

text: The visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
quote: The visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10.
test_case: Inspect per paragraph 5.10. that no red light from the lamp is visible from the front and white light towards the rear only as permitted (reversing lamp); pass if compliant.

text: The lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
quote: The lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation
test_case: Operate rear position, stop and reversing lamps and associated tell-tales; pass if behaviour conforms to paragraphs 5.11.-5.14. and individual specifications.

text: The electrical connections shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle.
quote: The electrical connections shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle.
test_case: Switch on each lamp function from the vehicle electrical system; pass if each function is activated by its intended control.

text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
quote: These shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
test_case: Compare inspected lamp presence, number, colour, arrangement and category with paragraphs 5.15., 5.16. and individual specifications; pass if all fulfilled.

text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings.
quote: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings.
test_case: Visually inspect lamps and approval markings on the vehicle; pass if presence, number, colour, arrangement and category are identified.

text: A separate approval is required for each lamp listed in paragraph 1.
quote: A separate approval is required for each lamp listed in paragraph 1.
test_case: Verify separate approvals exist for the rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions.

text: When two or more lamps are part of the same unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, approval may be granted only if each of these lamps satisfy the provisions set out in this Regulation or in another Regulation.
quote: When two or more lamps are part of the same unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, approval may be granted only if each of these lamps satisfy
test_case: Verify that each function in the combination unit (rear position, stop, reversing, retro-reflector) holds or meets the applicable Regulation's provisions.

text: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of such unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
quote: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of such unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
test_case: Check that no function in the unit lacks compliance with an applicable Regulation.

text: All the devices of an interdependent lamp system must be submitted for type approval by the same applicant.
quote: All the devices of an interdependent lamp system must be submitted for type approval by the same applicant.
condition: Lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system
test_case: Check approval documents show the same applicant for all interdependent devices.

text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
quote: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings
test_case: Inspect the lamp drawing/sample for a marking space large enough for all required markings.

text: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible,
test_case: Visually inspect markings and perform rub test; markings remain legible.

text: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for "a" shall be at least 5 mm.
quote: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” shall be at least 5 mm.
test_case: Measure dimension "a" of the approval marking; pass if ≥ 5 mm.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
quote: The approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
test_case: Inspect marking for circle with letter E and the country distinguishing number.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
quote: The four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
test_case: Inspect marking for a 4 to 6 digit sequential number matching the approval number.

text: The sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
quote: This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
test_case: Verify the sequential number is located adjacent to the E-mark circle.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
quote: The symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
test_case: Verify the marking includes the function symbols per Table 1 (e.g. R1/R2, S1/S2, AR).

text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
quote: The number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force
test_case: Verify marking shows "148R" followed by the series of amendments digits.

text: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval marking shall include a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
quote: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
condition: Lamp cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately (handed left/right variants)
test_case: Inspect handed lamp marking for a horizontal arrow indicating mounting side.

text: In the case of front or rear position lamps, front or rear end-outline marker lamps, the arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
quote: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of: (b) Front or rear position lamps, front or rear end-outline marker lamps;
condition: Lamp cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately
test_case: Verify the horizontal arrow on the rear position lamp points outwards from the vehicle when installed.

text: In the case of reversing lamps in case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps, the arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
quote: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of: (c) Reversing lamps in case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps.
condition: Reversing lamp approved with reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps
test_case: Verify the horizontal arrow on the reversing lamp points outwards from the vehicle.

text: If applicable, the additional letter "D" shall be placed to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4. on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps.
quote: If applicable, to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4.: (a) The additional letter "D", on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps;
condition: Lamp may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps
test_case: Inspect marking for letter D to the right of the function symbol.
merged: If applicable, the additional letter "Y" shall be placed to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4. on lamps which are used as part of an interdependent lamps system.

text: On lamps with reduced light distribution, see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3, the approval marking shall include a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
quote: On lamps with reduced light distribution, see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3, a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
condition: Lamp approved with reduced light distribution
test_case: Inspect marking for a downward vertical arrow from a horizontal segment.

text: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
quote: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
test_case: Inspect the lamp sample for presence of the approval marking.

text: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
quote: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant
test_case: Inspect the lamp for the applicant's trade name or mark.

text: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed.
quote: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, bear a marking indicating: (a) The category or categories of light source(s) prescribed;
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light sources
test_case: Inspect the lamp for marking of the prescribed light source categories.

text: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, in the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), also bear a marking indicating the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s).
quote: (b) in the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), also the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s);
condition: Lamp approved for LED substitute light sources
test_case: Inspect the lamp for marking of LED substitute light source categories.

text: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with non-replaceable light sources.
quote: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with: (d) Non-replaceable light sources.
condition: Lamp uses non-replaceable light sources (e.g. non-replaceable LEDs)
test_case: Inspect the lamp for the rated voltage or voltage range marking.

text: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with an electronic light source control gear.
quote: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with: (a) An electronic light source control gear;
condition: Lamp has an electronic light source control gear
test_case: Inspect the lamp for the rated voltage or voltage range marking.

text: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with a variable luminous intensity control.
quote: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with: (b) A variable luminous intensity control;
condition: Lamp has a variable luminous intensity control
test_case: Inspect the lamp for the rated voltage or voltage range marking.

text: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with a secondary operating mode.
quote: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with: (c) A secondary operating mode;
condition: Lamp has a secondary operating mode
test_case: Inspect the lamp for the rated voltage or voltage range marking.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
quote: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, bear the following markings. (a) On the light source module(s): (i) The trade name or mark of the applicant;
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source module(s)
test_case: Inspect each module for the applicant's trade name or mark.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the specific identification code of the module, comprising the starting letters "MD" followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1., followed by additional symbols or characters in case several non-identical light source modules are used.
quote: This specific identification code shall comprise the starting letters “MD” for “MODULE” followed by the approval mark without the circle
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source module(s)
test_case: Inspect module for code starting with MD followed by the approval mark without circle.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
quote: (iii) The rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source module(s)
test_case: Inspect each module for rated voltage or voltage range marking.
merged: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii).
quote: (b) On the lamp: (i) The specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii);
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source module(s)
test_case: Inspect the lamp for the module identification code.

text: The approval mark in the specific identification code of the light source module and the approval mark on the lamp in which the module is used shall be from the same applicant.
quote: The approval mark does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp in which the module is used, but both marks shall be from the same applicant;
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source module(s)
test_case: Compare module and lamp approval marks; both belong to the same applicant.

text: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
quote: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked
condition: Lamp has an electronic control gear or variable intensity control outside the lamp body
test_case: Inspect the external control gear for identification number and manufacturer name.

text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
quote: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated
test_case: Verify the marking is on a part not separable from the light-emitting lens.

text: In any case the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
quote: In any case the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted
test_case: Check on vehicle that the approval marking is visible as fitted or with boot lid/door opened.

text: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.
quote: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both
condition: Outer lens is designed to be separated from the main body
test_case: Inspect both detachable lens and main body for the approval marking.

text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
quote: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only
condition: Outer lens is shared by several devices bearing different approval markings
test_case: Inspect each device main body; it bears only the markings of its own functions.

text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
quote: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
test_case: Inspect the lamp for presence of all listed markings on the lamp itself.

text: The markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the component.
quote: The markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the component.
