condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source module(s)
test_case: Inspect the light source module for the 3.3.3.5(a) markings.

text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations bear a single approval mark, the marking shall be visible after their installation.
quote: a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number may be affixed. This marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps
condition: A single approval mark is used for the grouped/combined lamp functions (e.g. R148 and R150).
test_case: Inspect the lamp installed on the vehicle and confirm the single approval mark is visible.

text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, the single approval mark shall be visible after their installation.
quote: It is visible after their installation;
condition: A single approval mark is used for the grouped/combined lamp functions.
test_case: Inspect the lamp in installed position on the vehicle; the single approval mark must be visible.

text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark.
quote: No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.
condition: A single approval mark is used for the grouped/combined lamp functions.
test_case: Check the mark location (e.g. on the outer lens) and verify that no light-transmitting part can be removed without removing the mark.

text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
quote: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks
condition: A single approval mark is used for the grouped/combined lamp functions.
test_case: Measure the components of the single approval mark and compare with the minimum sizes required by the pertinent Regulations.

text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
quote: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
test_case: Review the test report to confirm all requirements of paragraphs 4 and 5 are verified as met.

text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to this Regulation.
quote: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86
test_case: Check that the applicable R48 section 5 and 6 requirements for the lamp are assessed at lamp type approval.

text: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
quote: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied
test_case: Verify that R48 requirements pertinent to rear position, stop and reversing lamps for M1 vehicles (e.g. geometric visibility) are checked where feasible at lamp approval.

text: The lamps shall be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
quote: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use
test_case: Assess design and perform vibration/durability checks followed by photometric and colorimetric re-measurement; characteristics must remain within limits.

text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source) or be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
quote: in the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either: (a) be provided by multiple light sources
condition: The rear position lamp and stop lamp are reciprocally incorporated using a common light source arrangement.
test_case: Review the circuit design: verify multiple light sources provide the functions or that the lamp is declared for vehicles with a failure tell-tale.

text: Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
quote: Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
test_case: Inspect the stop lamp and reversing lamp optics and lens; no logo shall be present within their apparent surfaces.

text: When the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) incorporates a manufacturer logo, it shall incorporate only one manufacturer logo and all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation shall be fulfilled.
quote: may incorporate only one manufacturer logo build by transparent or non-transparent components provided that all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation are fulfilled
condition: A manufacturer logo is incorporated in the rear position lamp apparent surface.
test_case: Inspect the lamp for logos and confirm only one logo is present and all photometric/colorimetric requirements of the function are met.

text: When a logo is incorporated, the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
quote: the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2
condition: A manufacturer logo is incorporated in the rear position lamp apparent surface.
test_case: Measure the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo in the reference axis direction; must be ≤ 100 cm2.

text: When a logo is incorporated, only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer is allowed, irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3.
quote: Irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer is allowed.
condition: A manufacturer logo is incorporated in the rear position lamp apparent surface.
test_case: Check the logo against the applicant statement; it must be the vehicle or body manufacturer brand logo.

text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
quote: a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source
test_case: Review LED wiring diagram to identify groups treated as one light source for the failure assessment.

text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply: (a) the light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or (b) a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced.
quote: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply
test_case: Simulate failure of each light source and measure intensities against Annex 3 minimum (and maxima with all sources on), or verify a failure tell-tale activation signal is produced.

text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
quote: A rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1
condition: The rear position lamp is category R2 with variable intensity control.
test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control and verify the lamp automatically reverts to steady intensity within category R1 limits.
merged: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a stop lamp category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category S1, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.

text: The lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
quote: The lamp shall only be equipped with: - replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128
test_case: Review BOM and design to confirm the LED light sources are non-replaceable, light source modules, or UN-approved replaceable light sources.

text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
quote: The design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one
condition: The lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources.
test_case: Attempt to fit the light source in incorrect orientations; fitting shall only be possible in the correct position.

text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed applying, and where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of LED substitute light source(s) applies.
quote: The light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061.
condition: The lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources.
test_case: Check holder dimensions against the relevant IEC 60061 data sheet.

text: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
quote: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
test_case: Perform EMC emission tests (e.g. per UN R10) and confirm no disturbances causing malfunction of other vehicle systems.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
quote: it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s)
condition: The lamp uses replaceable light source modules.
test_case: Attempt fitting in other positions and removal without tools; both shall be impossible.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it is tamperproof.
quote: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that
condition: The lamp uses replaceable light source modules.
test_case: Inspect module design for tamperproof construction.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that, regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source.
quote: regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with: - any replaceable UN approved light source
condition: The lamp uses replaceable light source modules.
test_case: Attempt to fit UN approved light sources in the module seat; must not be possible.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that, regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
quote: any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing
condition: The lamp uses replaceable light source modules.
test_case: Attempt to swap modules of different functions within the housing; must not be possible.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of device shall be met.
quote: when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code
condition: The lamp uses replaceable light source modules.
test_case: Replace the module with another having the same identification code and re-measure photometry; requirements must be met.

text: All measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be made with respect to the conditions of paragraph 4.8., with particulars of the methods of measurement given in Annex 3.
quote: All measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be made with respect to the following conditions.
test_case: Confirm the photometric and colorimetric test reports state measurement per paragraph 4.8 conditions and Annex 3 methods.

text: In the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, all measurements shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.
quote: In the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, all measurements shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.
condition: The lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources.
test_case: Verify test report records use of standard light sources per R.E.5.

text: In the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s) controlled by an electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control, the standard light source(s) shall have a luminous flux value that does not deviate more than 5 per cent from its reference/objective luminous flux value when test voltage is applied.
quote: the standard light source(s) shall have a luminous flux value that does not deviate more than 5 per cent from its reference/objective luminous flux value
condition: Lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources controlled by an electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control
test_case: Measure the luminous flux of the standard light source at test voltage; pass if within ±5% of the reference/objective value.

text: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
quote: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
condition: Lamp is equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable LED light sources
test_case: Review test report; pass if all photometric measurements were made with the LED light sources fitted in the lamp.

text: In case of a lamp (function) using light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., the photometric measurements shall be made separately, in accordance with each applicable condition(s) set forth in paragraph 4.8.
quote: the photometric measurements shall be made separately, in accordance with each applicable condition(s) set forth in paragraph 4.8.
condition: A lamp function uses light sources subject to more than one condition of paragraph 4.8.
test_case: Review test report; pass if photometry was measured separately for each applicable light source condition.

text: In case of a lamp (function) using light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., all separate measurement results shall be added together.
quote: All separate measurement results shall be added together.
condition: A lamp function uses light sources subject to more than one condition of paragraph 4.8.
test_case: Check that the reported intensities are the sum of the separate measurement results.

text: During photometric measurements, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
quote: During photometric measurements, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
test_case: Inspect photometric test setup; pass if masking is applied to prevent stray reflections.

text: In the case where the lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.
quote: the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer
condition: Lamp may be installed in more than one position or in a field of positions
test_case: Review test report; pass if photometry was repeated for each installation position or the extreme positions of the reference axis field.

text: In the case where the lamp, at the discretion of the applicant, also has to be approved with LED substitute light source(s), all measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be repeated using the LED substitute light source(s) prescribed.
quote: all measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be repeated using the LED substitute light source(s) prescribed
condition: Applicant requests approval with LED substitute light source(s)
test_case: Review test report; pass if photometric and colorimetric measurements were repeated with the LED substitute light sources.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
quote: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
test_case: Verify in the test setup that the light sources are continuously lit during intensity measurement.

text: In case the results of measurements should be challenged, the distance of measurement shall be such that the law of the inverse of the square of the distance is applicable.
quote: The distance of measurement shall be such that the law of the inverse of the square of the distance is applicable
test_case: Check the goniophotometer measurement distance satisfies the inverse square law for the lamp size.

text: In case the results of measurements should be challenged, the measuring equipment shall be such that the angular aperture of the receiver viewed from the reference centre of the light is comprised between 10' and 1 degree.
quote: the angular aperture of the receiver viewed from the reference centre of the light is comprised between 10' and 1 degree
test_case: Verify receiver angular aperture from the reference centre is between 10' and 1°.

text: In case the results of measurements should be challenged, the intensity requirement for a particular direction of observation shall be deemed to be satisfied if that requirement is met in a direction deviating by not more than one-quarter of a degree from the direction of observation.
quote: shall be deemed to be satisfied if that requirement is met in a direction deviating by not more than one-quarter of a degree
test_case: Where a point fails, check whether the requirement is met within 0.25° of the observation direction.

text: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of a light-signalling lamp shall be determined.
quote: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of a light-signalling lamp shall be determined.
test_case: Review test report/drawings; pass if the apparent surface limits in the reference axis direction are determined for each function.

text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp for testing shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
quote: the voltage supplied at the lamp shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems)
test_case: Measure supply voltage at the lamp terminals during testing; pass if 6.75 V, 13.5 V or 28 V according to the system voltage.

text: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
quote: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant
condition: Lamp is controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control
test_case: Verify the lamp is operated during tests according to the applicant's specified operating conditions.

text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
quote: in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant
condition: Lamp with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light sources, not controlled by electronic control gear or variable intensity control
test_case: Verify the lamp is operated during tests according to the applicant's specification.

text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s) the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction on the measured luminous intensities.
quote: the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction
condition: Lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources not controlled by electronic control gear or variable intensity control
test_case: Check the light sources were operated at reference flux, or intensities were proportionally corrected.

text: In case of lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources, the lamps shall be operated at a voltage or electrical current setting such that the actual luminous fluxes of the light sources do not deviate by more than 5 per cent from the average luminous flux of the light sources.
quote: shall be operated at a voltage or electrical current setting such that the actual luminous fluxes of the light sources do not deviate by more than 5 per cent
condition: Lamp is equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources
test_case: Measure flux of each light source; pass if each is within 5% of the average flux.

text: In case of lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources, the measured luminous intensities shall be corrected proportionally for the difference between the average luminous flux and the applicable reference/objective luminous flux.
quote: The measured luminous intensities shall be corrected proportionally for the difference between the average luminous flux and the applicable reference/objective luminous flux.
condition: Lamp is equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources
test_case: Check reported intensities include the proportional flux correction.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
quote: On the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
test_case: Measure intensity at HV on both samples for each function; pass if not less than the paragraph 5 minimum.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
quote: In no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum, specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
test_case: Scan intensity over all visible directions on both samples; pass if no value exceeds the paragraph 5 maximum.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5. by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question, or be not less than the intensity value as specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
quote: be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5., by the percentage specified
test_case: Measure intensities at the Annex 3 grid points; pass if each is at least the minimum times the specified percentage or the specified value.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
quote: Within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table
test_case: Measure intensity throughout the Annex 2 geometric visibility angles; pass if not below the specified minimum.

text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
quote: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
test_case: Evaluate light distribution against the Annex 3 local variation provisions; pass if compliant.

text: If the applicant requests the additional test to verify the visibility of red light towards the front and/or white light towards the rear of a vehicle, the maximum intensity in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard in horizontal direction and -2.5° to +5° in vertical direction shall be not more than 2.5∙10-1 cd.
quote: in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard in horizontal direction and -2.5° to +5° in vertical direction, the maximum intensity is not more than 2.5∙10-1cd
condition: Applicant requests the additional red-to-front / white-to-rear visibility test
test_case: Measure intensity in the 165°-180° outboard H / -2.5° to +5° V field; pass if max ≤ 0.25 cd.

text: When an assembly of two independent lamps, to be type approved as lamps marked "D" and having the same function, is deemed to be a single lamp, it shall comply with the requirements for maximum intensity if all lamps together are lit.
quote: it shall comply with the requirements for: (a) Maximum intensity if all lamps together are lit
condition: Function is provided by an assembly of two independent lamps marked "D"
test_case: Measure with both lamps lit; pass if maximum intensity limit is not exceeded.

text: When an assembly of two independent lamps, to be type approved as lamps marked "D" and having the same function, is deemed to be a single lamp, it shall comply with the requirements for minimum intensity if either lamp has failed.
quote: (b) Minimum intensity if either lamp has failed
condition: Function is provided by an assembly of two independent lamps marked "D"
test_case: Measure with each lamp failed in turn; pass if minimum intensities are met.

text: An interdependent lamp system shall meet the requirements when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
quote: An interdependent lamp system shall meet the requirements when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
condition: Function is provided by an interdependent lamp system
test_case: Measure with all interdependent lamps lit together; pass if all requirements are met.

text: If the interdependent lamp system providing the rear position lamp is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the applicant shall meet the outboard geometric visibility colorimetric and photometric requirement, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s); in this case, the inboard geometric visibility requirement is deemed to be satisfied if this (these) interdependent lamp(s) still conform to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the approval of the device, at all fixed positions of the moveable component(s).
quote: the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the applicant shall meet the outboard geometric visibility colorimetric and photometric requirement, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s)
condition: Rear position lamp is an interdependent lamp system split between fixed and movable components
test_case: Test specified lamps at all fixed positions of the movable component; pass if outboard visibility, colour and photometry are met.

text: The variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities outside the range specified in paragraph 5.
quote: The variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities: Outside the range specified in paragraph 5.
condition: Lamp uses variable intensity control (e.g. R2/S2)
test_case: Operate variable intensity control over all states; pass if intensities stay within the paragraph 5 range.

text: For systems depending only on daytime and night-time conditions, the variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities exceeding the respective steady luminous intensity maximum specified in paragraph 5. for the specific lamp under night-time conditions.
quote: Exceeding the respective steady luminous intensity maximum specified in paragraph 5. for the specific lamp: (a) For systems depending only on daytime and night-time conditions: under night-time conditions
condition: Lamp uses variable intensity control depending only on day/night conditions
test_case: Measure intensity in night-time mode; pass if not above the steady-lamp maximum.

text: For other variable intensity systems, the variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities exceeding the respective steady luminous intensity maximum specified in paragraph 5. for the specific lamp under standard conditions (good visibility, MOR > 2,000 m, and clean lens).
quote: (b) For other systems: under standard conditions
condition: Lamp uses another type of variable intensity control
test_case: Measure intensity under standard conditions; pass if not above the steady-lamp maximum.

text: If a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously at the intensity of the rear position lamp when turned on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table.
quote: the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously at the intensity of the rear position lamp
condition: Rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp
test_case: Measure both lamps on and position lamp alone within ±5° V / ±10° H; pass if ratio ≥ 5:1 at each point.

text: If one or both of the two reciprocally incorporated rear position lamp and stop lamp contain(s) more than one light source and is (are) considered as a single lamp, the values to be considered for the 5:1 ratio are those obtained with all sources in operation.
quote: the values to be considered are those obtained with all sources in operation
condition: Reciprocally incorporated rear position/stop lamp with more than one light source considered as a single lamp
test_case: Verify ratio measurements were made with all light sources operating.

text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
quote: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
test_case: Review test report; pass if luminous intensity compliance was assessed per Annex 8.

text: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
quote: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function
test_case: Measure chromaticity within the Annex 3 grid for each function; pass if within the specified colour boundaries.

text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.
quote: Outside this field no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.
test_case: Visually/colorimetrically inspect outside the grid; pass if no sharp colour variation is observed.

text: To check the colorimetric characteristics, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.
quote: To check these colorimetric characteristics, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.
test_case: Review colorimetric test report; pass if paragraph 4.8 test conditions were applied.

text: For lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
quote: for lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp
condition: Lamp is equipped with non-replaceable light sources
test_case: Verify colour measurements were made with the LED sources fitted in the lamp.

text: For lamps (functions) using different light source technologies, the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions in paragraphs 4.8.1. and 4.8.2.
quote: the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions
condition: A lamp function uses different light source technologies
test_case: Review report; pass if colour was checked separately per light source technology.

text: For rear position lamps of category R1 (steady), the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 4: minimum luminous intensity 4∙10^0 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), maximum luminous intensity 1.7∙10^1 cd when used as a single lamp or 8.5∙10^0 cd when used as a lamp marked "D" (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), standard light distribution according to Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), and angles of geometric visibility as defined in Table A2-1 with minimum luminous intensity 5∙10^-2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)).
quote: R1, MR or RM1 (steady) 4∙100 1.7∙101 8.5∙100 Figure A3-I Table A2-1 5∙10-2
condition: Rear position lamp is of category R1 (steady intensity)
test_case: Measure both samples: pass if HV ≥ 4 cd, max ≤ 17 cd (8.5 cd if "D"), Figure A3-I grid met and ≥ 0.05 cd within Table A2-1 angles.

text: For rear position lamps of category R2 (variable), the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 4: minimum luminous intensity 4∙10^0 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), maximum luminous intensity 4.2∙10^1 cd when used as a single lamp or 2.1∙10^1 cd when used as a lamp marked "D" (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), standard light distribution according to Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), and angles of geometric visibility as defined in Table A2-1 with minimum luminous intensity 5∙10^-2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)).
quote: R2 or RM2 (variable) 4∙100 4.2∙101 2.1∙101 Figure A3-I Table A2-1 5∙10-2
condition: Rear position lamp is of category R2 (variable intensity)
test_case: Measure both samples: pass if HV ≥ 4 cd, max ≤ 42 cd (21 cd if "D"), Figure A3-I grid met and ≥ 0.05 cd within Table A2-1 angles.

text: For rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps, a luminous intensity of up to 6.0∙10^1 cd shall be permitted only below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
quote: a luminous intensity of 6.0∙101 cd shall be permitted for rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps below a plane forming an angle of 5°
condition: Rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp
test_case: Measure rear position lamp intensity below 5° down; pass if ≤ 60 cd there and Table 4 maximum elsewhere.

text: The rear position lamps shall meet the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility given in Table 4.
quote: Minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility: See Table 4
test_case: Measure intensity within Table A2-1 angles; pass if ≥ 0.05 cd throughout.

text: The rear position lamps shall comply with the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
quote: Failure provisions: See paragraph 4.6.
test_case: Assess lamp against paragraph 4.6 failure provisions; pass if compliant.

text: The colour of light emitted by the rear position lamps shall be red.
quote: Colour: The colour of light emitted shall be red.
test_case: Measure chromaticity of the rear position lamp within the grid; pass if within the red colour boundaries.
merged: The colour of light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.

text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the stop lamp supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both samples; all values within the Table 7 limits for the declared category.
merged: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the reversing lamp supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10.

text: For a stop lamp of category S1 (steady), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 2.60∙10^2 cd when used as a single lamp and 1.30∙10^2 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", the standard light distribution shall be as defined in Figure A3-I, and the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 shall be 3∙10^-1 cd, as specified in Table 7.
condition: Stop lamp is approved as category S1 (steady intensity).
test_case: Measure intensity on the reference axis, at the Figure A3-I grid and over the Table A2-1 field; minimum ≥60 cd, maximum ≤260 cd (≤130 cd if marked "D"), ≥0.3 cd within geometric visibility.

text: For a stop lamp of category S2 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 7.30∙10^2 cd when used as a single lamp and 3.65∙10^2 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", the standard light distribution shall be as defined in Figure A3-I, and the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 shall be 3∙10^-1 cd (day) and 7∙10^-2 cd (night), as specified in Table 7.
condition: Stop lamp is approved as category S2 (variable intensity).
test_case: Measure in day and night conditions; minimum ≥60 cd, maximum ≤730 cd (≤365 cd if marked "D"), ≥0.3 cd (day) / ≥0.07 cd (night) within geometric visibility.

text: The minimum luminous intensity of the stop lamp within the angles of geometric visibility shall be as specified in Table 7.
quote: Minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility See Table 7.
test_case: Measure intensity over the Table A2-1 geometric visibility field; values not below the Table 7 minimum for the category.

text: The stop lamp shall meet the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
quote: Failure provisions: See paragraph 4.6.
test_case: Simulate light source failure per paragraph 4.6; lamp behaviour complies with paragraph 4.6.
merged: The reversing lamp shall meet the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.

text: For a reversing lamp of category AR, the minimum luminous intensity shall be 8.0∙10^1 cd and the standard light distribution shall be as defined in Figure A3-V, as specified in Table 10.
test_case: Measure intensity on the reference axis and at the Figure A3-V grid points; minimum ≥80 cd and grid values per Figure A3-V.

text: For a reversing lamp of category AR, the maximum luminous intensity shall not exceed 3.00∙10^2 cd in or above the H-plane, 6.00∙10^2 cd below the H-plane down to 5°D, and 8.00∙10^3 cd below 5°D, as specified in Table 10.
quote: in or above the h-plane below the h-plane, down to 5°D below 5°D
test_case: Scan intensity in all zones; ≤300 cd at/above H, ≤600 cd from H to 5°D, ≤8000 cd below 5°D.

text: In the case where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices and the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards, a photometric value of at least 2.5∙10^1 cd shall be satisfied.
quote: the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙101 cd shall be satisfied
condition: Reversing lamp is intended to be installed exclusively in a pair of devices.
test_case: Measure intensity at 30° inwards; value ≥25 cd.

text: The colour of light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
quote: Colour: The colour of light emitted shall be white.
test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the reversing lamp light through the lens; chromaticity within the white boundaries.

text: The angles of geometric visibility shown in these arrangements are correct for lamps to be mounted on the right side of the vehicle.
quote: The angles shown in these arrangements are correct for lamps to be mounted on the right side of the vehicle.
test_case: Check that geometric visibility verification of left-hand lamps uses the right-side arrangement mirrored, and right-hand lamps use it directly.

text: The front/rear position lamp (A, R1, R2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard / 80° outboard, as given in Table A2-1.
test_case: Measure the apparent surface visibility of the rear position lamp across horizontal angles and confirm it is unobstructed from 45° inboard to 80° outboard.
merged: The stop lamp (S1, S2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard / 45° outboard, as given in Table A2-1.

text: The front/rear position lamp (A, R1, R2) shall have minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility of 15° above / 15° below, as given in Table A2-1.
test_case: Check the rear position lamp apparent surface is visible from 15° above to 15° below the horizontal.
merged: The stop lamp (S1, S2) shall have minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility of 15° above / 15° below, as given in Table A2-1.

text: For front/rear position lamps (A, R1, R2) mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm, the reduced minimum horizontal angles of 20° inboard / 80° outboard may be used only below the H-plane, as given in Table A2-1.
quote: a Reduced angles used only below the H-plane for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm.
condition: Rear position lamp H-plane mounting height below 750 mm (mounting height not stated)
test_case: For a lamp with H-plane below 750 mm, verify visibility below the H-plane from 20° inboard to 80° outboard and above the H-plane from 45° inboard to 80° outboard.

text: For front/rear position lamps (A, R1, R2) to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm, the minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility shall be 15° above / 5° below, as given in Table A2-1.
quote: b For lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm.
condition: Rear position lamp H-plane mounting height less than 750 mm (mounting height not stated)
test_case: For a lamp with H-plane below 750 mm, verify visibility from 15° above to 5° below the horizontal.
merged: For stop lamps (S1, S2) to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm, the minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility shall be 15° above / 5° below, as given in Table A2-1.

text: For stop lamps (S1, S2) mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm, the reduced minimum horizontal angles of 20° inboard / 45° outboard may be used only below the H-plane, as given in Table A2-1.
quote: a Reduced angles used only below the H-plane for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm.
condition: Stop lamp H-plane mounting height below 750 mm (mounting height not stated)
test_case: For a lamp with H-plane below 750 mm, verify visibility below the H-plane from 20° inboard to 45° outboard and above the H-plane from 45° inboard to 45° outboard.

text: For optional front/rear position lamps (A, R1, R2) to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of more than 2,100 mm, the minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility shall be 5° above / 15° below, as given in Table A2-1.
quote: c Optional lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of more than 2,100 mm.
condition: Optional rear position lamp mounted with H-plane above 2,100 mm (unlikely for M1)
test_case: For an optional lamp with H-plane above 2,100 mm, verify visibility from 5° above to 15° below the horizontal.

text: For optional stop lamps (S1, S2) to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of more than 2,100 mm, the minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility shall be 5° above / 15° below, as given in Table A2-1.
quote: c Optional lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of more than 2,100 mm.
condition: Optional stop lamp mounted with H-plane above 2,100 mm (unlikely for M1)
test_case: For an optional lamp with H-plane above 2,100 mm, verify visibility from 5° above to 15° below the horizontal.

text: If not otherwise specified, the direction H = 0° and V = 0° corresponds to the reference axis, which passes through the centre of reference; the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, which shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.
quote: the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, which shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits
test_case: Check that the minimum intensity per measuring direction is calculated as the given percentage of the required minimum, rounded down to three significant digits, and that the measured values meet it.

text: In the case where the rear position lamp is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
quote: equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards
condition: Rear position lamp mounting height (manufacturer H plane) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground
test_case: Confirm the declared mounting height is ≤ 750 mm and verify the rear position lamp photometry down to 5° below horizontal only.
merged: In the case where the stop lamp of category S1, S2 or MS is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.

text: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
quote: the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value
test_case: Measure intensity at intermediate directions within each grid cell and verify each value is at least the lowest minimum percentage on the surrounding grid lines.

text: In the case of reversing lamps, if visual examination of a lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
quote: no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement referred to above is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity
test_case: Where visual inspection shows local intensity variations, measure the reversing lamp between measuring directions and verify no value is below 50% of the lower of the two prescribed minima.

text: The rear position lamps shall meet the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I, the values shown giving, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Table 4).
quote: The values shown give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required
test_case: Goniometer measurement of the rear position lamp at all Figure A3-I points; each value shall be at least the stated percentage of the required minimum.
merged: The stop lamps of category S1, S2 and MS shall meet the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I, the values shown giving, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Table 7).

text: The reversing lamps shall meet the standard light distribution of Figure A3-V, the values shown giving, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities in cd, the directions H = 0° and V = 0° corresponding to the axis of reference and passing through the centre of reference.
quote: The values shown in figure A3-V give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities in cd.
test_case: Goniometer measurement of the reversing lamp at all Figure A3-V points; each value shall be at least the minimum intensity in cd given.

text: The mass-produced lamps shall conform from a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, in accordance with the requirements of this Regulation, with differences not exceeding inevitable manufacturing deviations.
quote: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, in accordance with the requirements of this Regulation
test_case: Inspect randomly sampled production lamps against the approved drawings; pass if deviations stay within inevitable manufacturing deviations.

text: When testing the photometric performances set forth in paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation of any lamp chosen at random, no measured value shall deviate from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3. of this Regulation.
quote: No measured value deviates from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3. of this Regulation.
test_case: Measure photometry of randomly chosen production lamps per paragraph 4.8.; pass if all values are within the paragraph 6.1.3. limits.

text: In the case of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source, if results of the photometric test do not meet the requirements, tests on lamps shall be repeated using another standard light source.
quote: in the case of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source and if results of the test described above do not meet the requirements
condition: Lamp is equipped with a replaceable light source (not stated; LED modules assumed).
test_case: If a replaceable-light-source lamp fails photometry, repeat the test with another standard light source and check compliance.

text: The chromaticity coordinates of the mass-produced lamps shall be complied with when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
quote: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
test_case: Measure chromaticity of sampled red and white functions under paragraph 4.9. conditions; pass if coordinates are within the prescribed colour boundaries.

text: For lamps (functions) using incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
quote: For lamps (functions) using incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
condition: A lamp function uses incandescent technology only (spec states LED modules; to be confirmed against BOM).
test_case: Measure luminous intensities after photometric stability and confirm all test points are within the minimum and maximum values.

text: For reversing lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
quote: For reversing lamps and manoeuvring lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation, shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
test_case: Measure (or calculate via HV ratio) the reversing lamp intensity distribution after 1 min and 10 min of operation and confirm all points are within the minimum and maximum values.

text: For rear position lamps and stop lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
quote: For all other lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either - after 30 minutes of operation, or - after photometric stability has occurred shall comply
test_case: Measure (or calculate via HV ratio) the rear position and stop lamp intensity distributions after 1 min and after 30 min or photometric stability and confirm all points are within the minimum and maximum values.

text: For front and rear position lamps, the luminous intensity distribution shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 4 seconds after switch ON, using HV as reference coordinate, as listed in Table A8-1.
quote: the luminous intensity distribution is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1.
test_case: Measure HV intensity of the rear position lamp at 4 s after switch ON, scale the distribution by the HV ratio and confirm compliance with minimum and maximum values.
merged: For stop lamps, the luminous intensity distribution shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 0.2 seconds after switch ON, using HV as reference coordinate, as listed in Table A8-1.

text: For reversing lamps, the luminous intensity distribution shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 0.2 seconds after switch ON, using HV as reference coordinate, as listed in Table A8-1.
quote: the luminous intensity distribution is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1.
test_case: Measure HV intensity of the reversing lamp at 0.2 s after switch ON, scale the distribution by the HV ratio and confirm compliance with minimum and maximum values.

text: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, the lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.
quote: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, a lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time
condition: The lamp function uses LED technology only (spec states LED modules; to be confirmed against BOM).
test_case: Confirm the function uses LED only and that values measured per paragraph 1.2. comply with the minimum and maximum values.

text: In case a lamp (function) uses any other light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of the lamp (function) shall be tested and checked for compliance at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
quote: the corresponding intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested and checked for compliance at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1
condition: A lamp function uses a light generating technology other than incandescent or LED.
test_case: Measure intensities from the Table A8-1 time point until photometric stability and confirm compliance throughout.

text: In case a lamp (function) uses more than one light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of the lamp (function) shall be tested following the strictest time requirements according to paragraphs 2.1.1. to 2.1.3. for the combination of them and checked for compliance.
quote: In case a lamp (function) uses more than one light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested following the strictest time requirements
condition: A lamp function uses more than one light generating technology.
test_case: Identify technologies used, apply the strictest time requirement of paragraphs 2.1.1. to 2.1.3. and confirm intensity compliance.

text: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of a lamp (function) shall be tested and checked for compliance at all points in time starting at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
quote: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested and checked for compliance at all points in time
test_case: If run-up behaviour is unexpected, record intensity continuously from the Table A8-1 time point to photometric stability and confirm minimum values are met at all times.

text: A separate approval is required for each retro-reflective device listed in paragraph 1.
quote: A separate approval is required for each retro-reflective device listed in paragraph 1.
test_case: Check that the retro-reflector holds its own UN R150 approval, separate from the lamp function approvals.

text: The approval number assigned to each type approved shall be marked on the device following the requirements of paragraph 3.3.
quote: An approval number shall be assigned to each type approved and shall be marked on the device following the requirements of paragraph 3.3.
test_case: Inspect the device and confirm the approval number is marked in accordance with paragraph 3.3.

text: The symbol identifying the retro-reflective device shall be IA for a retro-reflector for motor vehicles (independent) or IB for a retro-reflector for motor vehicles (combined with other signal lamps which are not watertight), with a minimum "a" of 5 mm, as given in Table 1.
quote: Retro-reflector for motor vehicles (independent) IA 5 5.1. Retro-reflector for motor vehicles (combined with other signal lamps which are not watertight) IB 5
condition: Retro-reflector class (IA or IB) not stated
test_case: Check that the marked class symbol matches the retro-reflector class (IA or IB) and that 'a' is at least 5 mm.

text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
quote: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement
test_case: Inspect the drawings and samples to confirm a marking space large enough for the UI or the approval marking and the other markings.

text: The markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
test_case: Visually inspect the markings for legibility and carry out a rub/durability test for indelibility.

text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for "a" shall be as defined in Table 1.
quote: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” is defined in Table 1.
test_case: Measure the approval marking and confirm 'a' is at least the Table 1 value (5 mm for IA/IB).

text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
quote: The approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
test_case: Inspect the marking for a circle surrounding 'E' and the country number.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2., placed close to the approval mark.
quote: The four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2. This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
test_case: Verify that the 4-6 digit sequential number is present and positioned close to the approval mark.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
quote: The symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
test_case: Verify that the class symbol (IA or IB) is present in the approval marking.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R" and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
quote: The number of this Regulation followed by the letter “R” and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue
test_case: Verify that '150R' followed by the series digits (e.g. 01) is present in the marking.

text: Where the approval marking is replaced by the Unique Identifier, the Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown in Figure I.
quote: The Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown below: Figure I Unique Identifier (UI)
condition: Whether a Unique Identifier is used instead of the approval marking
test_case: If a UI is used, compare its format with Figure I.

text: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
quote: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
test_case: Inspect the device for the applicant's trade name or mark.

text: In case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, retro-reflective devices shall bear the word "TOP" inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
quote: the word “TOP” inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle
condition: Whether a TOP indication is needed to determine the angle(s) of rotation unambiguously
test_case: If the rotation angle is not unambiguous, check that 'TOP' is inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface.

text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retro-reflective device.
quote: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.
test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflective device to confirm all markings are clearly legible.

text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps found to comply with several UN Regulations carry a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier, this marking shall be visible after their installation.
quote: a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier may be affixed. ... It is visible after their installation.
condition: Whether a single common approval mark is used for the combination lamp
test_case: With the lamp installed, check that the single approval mark is visible.

text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps carry a single approval mark, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
quote: No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark
condition: Whether a single common approval mark is used for the combination lamp
test_case: Check by design review and disassembly that no light-transmitting part can be removed without removing the approval mark.

text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
quote: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks
condition: Whether a single common approval mark is used for the combination lamp
test_case: Measure the single approval mark components and compare them with the minimum sizes of the individual regulations.

text: Every modification of the type of retro-reflective device shall be notified to the Type Approval Authority which approved the type.
quote: Every modification of the type of retro-reflective device shall be notified to the Type Approval Authority which approved the type.
test_case: Check the change-management records to confirm modifications were notified to the approving authority.

text: The requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval, pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed, shall be applied where their verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.
quote: The requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied
test_case: Review the R48 sections 5 and 6 provisions for M1 rear retro-reflectors that can be verified at component approval and confirm compliance.

text: The retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
quote: Retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
test_case: Inspect samples and review results of the full test sequence; the retro-reflector functions satisfactorily throughout.

text: The retro-reflective devices shall not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.
quote: they must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.
test_case: Visual and design inspection of samples; no defects detrimental to operation or maintenance are found.

text: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
quote: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
test_case: Attempt to dismantle the retro-reflector by hand without tools; components cannot be easily separated.

text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.
quote: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.
test_case: Inspect the outer lens surface over the retro-reflector; it can be easily cleaned.

text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall not be rough and any protuberances the outer surface of retro-reflective devices may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
quote: The surface shall therefore not be rough and any protuberances they may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
test_case: Visual and tactile inspection of the outer surface; no roughness and no protuberances preventing cleaning.

text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.
quote: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.
test_case: Inspect the assembled lamp; the inner surface of the retro-reflector is not accessible in normal use.

text: Where retro-reflectors consist of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, the retro-reflecting optical unit and filter shall be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
quote: Retro-reflectors may consist of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, which must be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
condition: The retro-reflector consists of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter (e.g. red-tinted lens over prism optics).
test_case: Inspect the construction; optical unit and filter cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.

text: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.
quote: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.
test_case: Review material specification and inspect parts; colour is achieved in the material, not by paint or varnish.

text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
quote: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device
test_case: Measure trichromatic coordinates of retro-reflected light; they lie within the R48 night-time red boundaries.

text: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1. shall be used.
quote: the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0°
test_case: Check the colorimetric test report states Illuminant A, 1/3° divergence and β1 = β2 = 0° (or Annex 4 angle).

text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
quote: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet: (a) The dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5
test_case: Measure the retro-reflector shape and dimensions against Annex 5; all requirements met.

text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
quote: (b) The photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
test_case: Perform photometric and colorimetric tests; results meet paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.

text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.
quote: (c) The physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.
test_case: Perform physical and mechanical tests per 5.1.7.; all are passed.

text: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
quote: the ten samples shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined
test_case: Subject samples to Annex 6 Part 1 heat test, then after ≥1 h verify colour and RI at 20', β1 = β2 = 0°.

text: The first group of two retro-reflector samples shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).
quote: First group: The two samples shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6)
test_case: Perform water penetration test and then fuel and lubricant resistance tests on two samples; samples pass.

text: The second group of two retro-reflector samples shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.
quote: Second group: The two samples shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6
test_case: Perform corrosion test (if applicable) and rear-face abrasion test on two samples; samples pass.

text: The third group of two retro-reflector samples shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties of retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.
quote: Third group: The two samples shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties of retro-reflective device
test_case: Perform Annex 4 Part 3 stability test on two samples; optical properties remain compliant.

text: The fourth group of two retro-reflector samples shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
quote: Fourth group: The two samples shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
test_case: Perform Annex 6 Part 6 weathering test on two samples; samples pass.

text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
quote: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have: A colour which satisfies the conditions
test_case: Measure colour of each group's samples after testing; coordinates within the 5.1.5 limits.

text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4., verified only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
quote: A RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4. The verification shall be performed only for an angle of divergence of 20'
test_case: Measure RI at 20', β1 = β2 = 0° after testing; values meet 5.1.4 minima.

text: In the case where more than one or a range of different axis of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the photometric measurements shall be repeated making reference each time to a different axis of reference or to the extreme axis of reference of the range specified by the manufacturer.
quote: the photometric measurements shall be repeated making reference each time to a different axis of reference or to the extreme axis of reference
condition: More than one or a range of axes of reference is specified by the manufacturer.
test_case: Check photometric report covers each specified axis of reference or the extremes of the range; all compliant.

text: For photometric measurements, only the illuminating surface defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system of the retro-reflective device as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA or IB shall be considered, and the illuminating surface itself shall be limited to 100 cm2.
quote: contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA or IB shall be considered, and the illuminating surface itself shall be limited to 100 cm2
test_case: Check the illuminating surface used for photometry lies within a 200 mm circle and does not exceed 100 cm2.
