text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Class IA and IB at an angle of divergence of 20' shall be equal to or greater than 300 mcd/lx at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°; 200 mcd/lx at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; and 100 mcd/lx at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°, as given in Table 3.
quote: the RI values for red retro-reflectors must be equal to or greater than those in Table 3, expressed in millicandelas per lux
test_case: Goniophotometric measurement at 20' divergence; RI ≥ 300/200/100 mcd/lx at the specified angles.
merged: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Class IA and IB at an angle of divergence of 1°30' shall be equal to or greater than 5 mcd/lx at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°; 2.8 mcd/lx at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; and 2.5 mcd/lx at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°, as given in Table 3.

text: RI values lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 are not permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the lines (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
quote: RI values lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 are not permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference
test_case: Scan RI within the bounded solid angle; no value falls below the corresponding Table 3 minimum.

text: Where a retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
quote: is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values are verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards
condition: The retro-reflector is intended to be installed with its H plane less than 750 mm above the ground.
test_case: Confirm intended mounting height; if below 750 mm, RI verified down to 5° downwards and compliant.

text: The testing of the colour for retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.
quote: The testing of the colour for retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.
test_case: Check the colour test report references the paragraph 4.2.1 method.

text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux shall be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
quote: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux must be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white
test_case: Measure chromaticity of the reflected flux; coordinates within the R48 night-time red limits.

text: Retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB shall be tested in the chronological order of tests given in Table 4 (Classes IA, IB, IIIA and IIIB).
quote: Table 4 Chronological order of tests (Classes IA, IB, IIIA and IIIB) Reference Tests Samples a b c d e f g h i j
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB (not stated in specification)
test_case: Review the test report and confirm that the tests on samples a to j were performed in the sequence of Table 4.

text: In accordance with Table 4, the samples of the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to the heat test of Part 1 of Annex 6 for 48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C, followed by a visual inspection for distortion.
quote: Part 1 of Annex 6 Heat: 48 h at 65° ± 2°C Visual inspection for distortion
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB
test_case: Expose the samples to 65 °C ± 2 °C for 48 h and inspect them visually; no distortion is allowed.

text: In accordance with Table 4, the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to photometry as per Part 1 of Annex 4, limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
quote: Part 1 of Annex 4 Photometry: limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB
test_case: Measure the CIL at 20' observation angle and β1 = β2 = 0°; the values must meet the specified minimum.

text: In accordance with Table 4, two samples of the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to complete photometry as per Part 1 of Annex 4.
quote: Part 1 of Annex 4 Complete photometry x x
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB
test_case: Perform full photometry on two samples at all specified angles; all values must meet the requirements.

text: In accordance with Table 4, the samples of the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to the water test of Part 3 of Annex 6 for 10 min in normal position and 10 min in inverted position, followed by visual inspection, colorimetry as per paragraph 4.2 and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
quote: Part 3 of Annex 6 Water: 10 min. in normal position 10 min. in inverted position visual inspection
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB
test_case: Immerse the samples for 10 min upright and 10 min inverted, then inspect for water penetration and recheck colour and photometry; all results must comply.

text: In accordance with Table 4, all samples of the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to a visual inspection of the general specifications.
quote: -General specifications: visual inspection x x x x x x x x x x
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB
test_case: Visually inspect all ten samples against the general specifications of paragraph 4; no non-conformity is allowed.

text: In accordance with Table 4, all samples of the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to a visual inspection of the shapes and dimensions as per Annex 5.
quote: Annex 5 Shapes and dimensions: visual inspection x x x x x x x x x x
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB
test_case: Inspect all ten samples for shape and dimensions against Annex 5; all samples must comply.

text: In accordance with Table 4, after the heat test the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to colorimetry as per paragraph 4.2 by visual inspection, with trichromatic coordinates measured in case of doubt.
quote: Par. 4.2. Colorimetry: visual inspection Trichromatic coordinates in case of doubt
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB
test_case: Visually check the colour after heat exposure and measure the trichromatic coordinates if in doubt; the result must be within the limits of paragraph 4.2.

text: In accordance with Table 4, the samples of the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to the motor fuels test of Part 1 of Annex 7 for 5 min, followed by visual inspection.
quote: Part 1 of Annex 7 Motor fuels: 5 min. visual inspection x x x x
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB
test_case: Expose the samples to the test fuel for 5 min and inspect visually; no visible surface alteration is allowed.

text: In accordance with Table 4, the samples of the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to the oils test of Part 2 of Annex 7 for 5 min, followed by visual inspection, colorimetry as per paragraph 4.2 and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
quote: Part 2 of Annex 7 Oils: 5 min. visual inspection x x x x
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB
test_case: Expose the samples to the test oil for 5 min, inspect them visually and recheck colour and photometry; all results must comply.

text: In accordance with Table 4, the samples of the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to the corrosion test of Part 4 of Annex 6 (24 hours, 2 hours interval, 24 hours), followed by visual inspection.
quote: Part 4 of Annex 6 Corrosion: 24 hours 2 hours interval 24 hours visual inspection
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB
test_case: Run salt spray for 24 h, pause 2 h, then run a further 24 h and inspect visually; no corrosion that impairs performance is allowed.

text: In accordance with Table 4, the samples of the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to the rear face test of Part 4 of Annex 6 for 1 min, followed by visual inspection, colorimetry as per paragraph 4.2 and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
quote: Part 4 of Annex 6 Rear face: 1 min. visual inspection x x x x
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB
test_case: Apply the rear face test for 1 min, inspect visually and recheck colour and photometry; all results must comply.

text: In accordance with Table 4, the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to the stability in time test of Part 3 of Annex 4, followed by colorimetry as per paragraph 4.2 (visual inspection or trichromatic coordinates) and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
quote: Part 3 of Annex 4 Stability in time Par. 4.2. Colorimetry: Visual inspection or trichromatic coordinates
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB
test_case: After the stability in time exposure, check colour and photometry at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°; the values must remain within limits.

text: In accordance with Table 4, the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test of Part 6 of Annex 6, followed by colorimetry as per paragraph 4.2 (visual inspection or trichromatic coordinates) and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
quote: Part 6 of Annex 6 Resistance to weathering Par. 4.2. Colorimetry: Visual inspection or trichromatic coordinates
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB
test_case: After the weathering exposure, check colour and photometry at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°; the values must remain within limits.

text: When the RI of a retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, it shall be ascertained whether any mirror effect is produced by slightly turning the device.
quote: When the RI of a retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, it shall be ascertained whether any mirror effect is produced
test_case: During photometry at β1 = β2 = 0°, slightly turn the retro-reflector and record whether a mirror effect occurs.

text: If any mirror effect is produced when the RI of a retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, a reading shall be taken with an angle β of β1 = -5°, β2 = 0°.
quote: If there is any such effect, a reading shall be taken with an angle β of β1 = -5°, β2 = 0°.
test_case: If a mirror effect is observed, measure RI at β1 = -5°, β2 = 0° and compare with the specified value.

text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
quote: retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified
condition: Retro-reflector is not marked "TOP"
test_case: Rotate the unmarked retro-reflector about its reference axis at β = 0°, α = 20', find minimum RI and verify it meets the paragraph 5 value.

text: When the RI is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the retro-reflective device not marked "TOP" shall be placed in the position corresponding to this value of ε, and if the specified values are not attained, the device may be rotated about its axis of reference ±5° from that position.
quote: When the RI is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the retro-reflective device shall be placed in the position corresponding to this value of ε.
condition: Retro-reflector is not marked "TOP"
test_case: Measure RI at all other specified angles with the device fixed at the minimum-RI ε position (±5° allowed) and verify compliance.

text: For retro-reflective devices marked "TOP", the RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during the ±5° rotation about their axes.
quote: The RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during this rotation.
condition: Retro-reflector is marked "TOP"
test_case: Record RI throughout the ±5° rotation; pass if no reading falls below the prescribed value.

text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes ±5°.
quote: and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes ±5°.
condition: Retro-reflector is marked "TOP"
test_case: Rotate the TOP-marked retro-reflector ±5° about its axis at β = 0°, α = 20' while measuring RI.

text: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.
quote: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more
test_case: If RI at β = 0°, ε = 0° is ≥150 % of the specified value, verify all angle measurements are made at ε = 0°.

text: The CIE-angular system as shown in Figure A4-I shall be used for specifying and measuring retro-reflective device and marking materials.
quote: The CIE-angular system as shown in Figure A4-I shall be used for specifying and measuring retro-reflective device and marking materials.
test_case: Check the test report states measurements were made in the CIE angular system per Figure A4-I.

text: For testing the retro-reflection the retro-reflective devices shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.
quote: For testing the retro-reflection the retro-reflective devices shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006)
test_case: Verify the test report records illumination with CIE Standard Illuminant A and measurement per Annex 4 Part 1.

text: For the measurement of retro-reflective devices, the measuring geometry shall respect the limits: angular diameter of the source δ ≤ 10', angular diameter of the measuring device γ ≤ 10', angular diameter of the illuminated area η ≤ 80'.
quote: Angular diameter of the source -δ≤10' Angular diameter of the measuring device -γ≤10' Angular diameter of the illuminated area -η≤80'
test_case: Check the test setup geometry: δ ≤ 10', γ ≤ 10', η ≤ 80'.

text: The measuring distance shall be chosen in such an order that at least the limits for the angles δ, γ and η are respected, but not lower than 10 m.
quote: The measuring distance shall be chosen in such an order that at least the limits for the angles δ, γ and η given above
test_case: Verify the recorded measuring distance is at least 10 m and meets the δ, γ, η limits.

text: The illuminance over the useful area of the retro-reflective device, measured perpendicular to the incident light, shall be sufficiently uniform, with the variation in the value of the illuminance complying with max/min ≤ 1.05.
quote: The illuminance over the useful area of the retro-reflective device, measured perpendicular to the incident light shall be sufficiently uniform.
test_case: Measure illuminance across the useful area with a sensor ≤1/10 of the area; pass if max/min ≤ 1.05.

text: For retro-reflective devices of Class IA or IB, the shape of the illuminating surfaces shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
quote: The shape of the illuminating surfaces shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1.
condition: Retro-reflector is approved as Class IA or IB (class not stated in the specification).
test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector illuminating surface from 10 m; pass if its shape cannot easily be confused with the equilateral triangle of Classes IIIA/IIIB.

text: Compliance with the shape and dimension specifications shall be verified by visual inspection.
quote: Compliance with the above specifications shall be verified by visual inspection.
condition: Applicable only if the shape verification provision is applied to the Class IA/IB retro-reflector.
test_case: Perform visual inspection of the retro-reflector shape and record compliance with the Annex 5 shape specifications.

text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, SMV and advance warning triangle of type 1, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.
quote: The retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C
test_case: Condition the retro-reflector sample at 65 °C ± 2 °C dry for 48 h, then cool 1 h at 23 °C ± 2 °C, and record conditions as per procedure.

text: After the resistance to heat test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.
quote: After this test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.
test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector after heat conditioning; pass if no cracking or appreciable distortion, especially of the optical component.

text: Retro-reflective devices whether part of a lamp or not shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
quote: Retro-reflective devices whether part of a lamp or not, or a sample unit of retro-reflective marking, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes
test_case: Strip removable parts and immerse the device for 10 min in 50 °C ± 5 °C water with the illuminating surface top 20 mm below the surface.

text: The water immersion test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
quote: This test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom
test_case: Repeat the 50 °C immersion with the device inverted, rear face covered by about 20 mm of water.

text: The retro-reflective device sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
quote: These sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
test_case: Immediately after the 50 °C immersions, immerse the device under the same conditions in 25 °C ± 5 °C water.

text: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.
quote: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.
test_case: Visually inspect after immersion; pass if no water is present on the reflecting surface.

text: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the retro-reflective device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
quote: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
test_case: Visual inspection after immersion; any clearly visible water means failure.

text: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, in the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
quote: In the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation
test_case: Shake off excess water and measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2.; pass if RI meets the paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. criteria.

text: For retro-reflective devices of the Classes IB and IIIB, as an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the moisture and dust tests of Part 3 of Annex 6 shall be applied.
quote: As an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the following tests (moisture and dust test) shall be applied.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Check the test report records the manufacturer's request and that both the moisture and dust tests were performed.

text: In the moisture test, the precipitation rate of the water spray at the device shall be 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min as measured with a vertical cylindrical collector centred on the vertical axis of the rotating test platform.
quote: The precipitation rate of the water spray at the device shall be 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative moisture test is chosen
test_case: Verify the measured precipitation rate in the test log is between 2.5 and 4.1 mm/min.

text: A sample device mounted on a test fixture, with initial RI measured and recorded, shall be subjected to a water spray as specified in paragraphs 2.2.1 to 2.2.6.
quote: A sample device mounted on a test fixture, with initial RI measured and recorded shall be subjected to a water spray as follows:
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative moisture test is chosen
test_case: Check the report shows the initial RI measured and recorded before the water spray test.

text: During the water spray test, all drain holes and other openings of the device shall remain open.
quote: All drain holes and other openings shall remain open.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative moisture test is chosen
test_case: Inspect the test set-up and confirm that no drain hole or opening is blocked.
merged: During the dust exposure test, all drain holes and other openings of the device shall remain open.

text: During the water spray test, drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
quote: Drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB, the alternative moisture test is chosen and drain wicks are used
test_case: Confirm that the drain wicks are fitted in the sample during the test.

text: During the water spray test, the device shall be rotated about its vertical axis at a rate of 4.0 ± 0.5 min-1.
quote: The device shall be rotated about its vertical axis at a rate of 4.0 ± 0.5 min -1.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative moisture test is chosen
test_case: Verify the recorded rotation rate is between 3.5 and 4.5 min-1.

text: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF.
quote: these functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative moisture test is chosen
test_case: Check that the position, stop and reversing lamps were operated at design voltage on a 5 min ON / 55 min OFF cycle during the spray test.

text: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
quote: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative moisture test is chosen
test_case: Verify the test log shows 12 cycles totalling 12 h.

text: After the water spray test, the rotation and the water spray shall be turned OFF and the device allowed to drain for 1 hour with the cabinet door closed.
quote: The rotation and the water spray shall be turned OFF and the device allowed to drain for 1 hour with the cabinet door closed.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative moisture test is chosen
test_case: Confirm that a 1 h drain period with the cabinet door closed is recorded.

text: Upon completion of the drain period, no standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed in the device, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
quote: No standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative moisture test is chosen
test_case: Tap and tilt the device after draining; pass if no standing pool of water is present or forms.

text: Upon completion of the drain period, the RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device with a dry cotton cloth.
quote: The RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative moisture test is chosen
test_case: Dry the exterior with a cotton cloth and measure RI per Annex 4 Part 1; record and compare with the initial RI.

text: Upon completion of the drain period, the interior of the device shall be observed for moisture accumulation.
quote: Upon completion of the drain period. The interior of the device shall be observed for moisture accumulation.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative moisture test is chosen
test_case: Visually inspect the interior after draining and record any moisture.

text: The test dust used in the dust exposure test shall be fine powdered cement in accordance with standard ASTM C 150-84.
quote: The test dust used shall be fine powdered cement in accordance with standard ASTM C 150-84.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative dust test is chosen
test_case: Check that the test report identifies ASTM C 150-84 cement as the test dust.

text: A sample device, mounted on a test fixture, with the initial RI measured and recorded, shall be exposed to dust as specified in paragraphs 2.3.5 to 2.3.7.
quote: A sample device, mounted on a test fixture, with the initial RI measured and recorded, shall be exposed to dust as follows:
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative dust test is chosen
test_case: Check the report shows the initial RI measured and recorded before dust exposure.

text: During the dust exposure test, drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
quote: Drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB, the alternative dust test is chosen and drain wicks are used
test_case: Confirm that the drain wicks are fitted during dust exposure.

text: The test dust shall be agitated as completely as possible by compressed air or blower(s) at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s for the duration of 5 hours.
quote: The test dust shall be agitated as completely as possible by compressed air or blower(s) at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative dust test is chosen
test_case: Verify the log shows agitation of 2-15 s every 15 min over 5 h.

text: The mounted device shall be placed in the dust chamber no closer than 150 mm from a wall.
quote: The mounted device shall be placed in the dust chamber no closer than 150 mm from a wall.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative dust test is chosen
test_case: Measure the distance from the device to each chamber wall; pass if ≥150 mm.

text: The dust shall be allowed to settle between the agitation periods.
quote: The dust shall be allowed to settle between the agitation periods.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative dust test is chosen
test_case: Confirm there is no agitation between the scheduled periods.

text: Devices with a length exceeding 600 mm shall be horizontally centred in the test chamber.
quote: Devices with a length exceeding 600 mm shall be horizontally centred in the test chamber.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB, the alternative dust test is chosen and the device length exceeds 600 mm
test_case: Confirm the device is horizontally centred if its length exceeds 600 mm.

text: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
quote: the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative dust test is chosen
test_case: Clean and dry the exterior, measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. and compare with the initial RI.

text: The retro-reflective devices shall be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.
quote: Retro-reflective devices must be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences
test_case: Perform the ISO 9227:2017 corrosion test and verify that photometric and colorimetric characteristics remain within the prescribed limits.

text: The resistance of the front surface of the retro-reflective device to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.
quote: The resistance of the front surface to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked
test_case: Inspect the front surface for tarnishing and the rear face protection for deterioration after the corrosion test; no deterioration is permitted.

text: The testing of resistance to corrosion of the retro-reflective devices shall be as described in ISO Standard 9227:2017.
quote: The description of the testing of resistance to corrosion is given in ISO Standard 9227:2017.
test_case: Check that the test report references corrosion testing per ISO 9227:2017.

text: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
quote: or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist
test_case: Verify the combined lamp, stripped of removable parts, is exposed to saline mist 24 h + 2 h drying + 24 h.

text: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
quote: the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts
condition: Retro-reflective device has essential metal components susceptible to corrosion
test_case: Check test records for a 5% NaCl solution atomized at 35 °C ± 2 °C with distilled water ≤0.02% impurities.

text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
quote: Immediately after completion of the test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
test_case: Visually inspect the sample immediately after the saline mist test; no excessive corrosion impairing efficiency.

text: After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.
quote: when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5°
test_case: After 48 h recovery measure RA at β2 = 5°, α = 20' and compare with Tables 9 and 10.

text: Before measuring the coefficient of retro-reflection after the corrosion test, the surface shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist.
quote: Before measuring, the surface shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist.
test_case: Verify the surface was cleaned of salt deposits before the post-test photometric measurement.

text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA and IB with an accessible mirror-backed rear face, the reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed with a hard nylon brush.
quote: The reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed with a hard nylon brush.
condition: Retro-reflector is a mirror-backed device with an accessible rear face
test_case: Verify the reverse side is brushed with a hard nylon brush as the first step of the rear face resistance test.

text: After having brushed, in the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB and IVA, the rear face of the retro-reflective device, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute.
quote: a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture, defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute
condition: Retro-reflector is a mirror-backed device with an accessible rear face
test_case: Apply a cotton cloth soaked in the Annex 7 Part 1 mixture to the brushed rear face for 1 min, then remove and let dry.

text: As soon as evaporation is completed, the reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed with the same brush as before.
quote: As soon as evaporation is completed, the reverse side shall be brushed with the same brush as before.
condition: Retro-reflector is a mirror-backed device with an accessible rear face
test_case: Verify the reverse side is brushed again with the same nylon brush after evaporation.

text: The RI of the retro-reflective device shall then be measured, according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, after the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face has been covered with Indian ink.
quote: The RI shall then be measured, according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, after the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face
condition: Retro-reflector is a mirror-backed device with an accessible rear face
test_case: Cover the mirror-backed rear face with Indian ink and measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2.; values must meet the requirements.

text: The accelerated artificial weathering apparatus shall be in accordance with EN ISO 4892-1:2016 and EN ISO 4892-2:2013 and shall be capable to control temperature and relative humidity and shall be equipped with a water spray system.
quote: The apparatus shall be in accordance with EN ISO 4892-1:2016 and EN ISO 4892-2:2013 and shall be capable to control temperature and relative humidity
test_case: Review the test laboratory apparatus records; pass if the apparatus conforms to EN ISO 4892-1/-2, controls temperature and humidity, and has a water spray system.

text: The test method used for accelerated artificial weathering (TM1 or TM2) shall be specified in the report.
quote: The test method used shall be specified in the report.
test_case: Check the weathering test report; pass if it states whether TM1 or TM2 was used.

text: The samples shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1.
quote: The samples shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1:
test_case: Review the weathering test report; pass if exposure followed EN ISO 4892-2:2013 with the Table A6-1 parameters.

text: In case of retro-reflective devices, the samples shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1 for a period of 500 hours.
quote: in case of retro-reflective devices for a period of 500 hours,
test_case: Expose retro-reflector samples in the xenon tester and verify the logged exposure duration is 500 hours.

text: When test method TM1 (Black-standard thermometer) is used, the samples shall be exposed with cycle No. 1 according to EN ISO 4892-2:2013: 102 min dry and 18 min water spray, irradiance 60 ± 2 W/m² broadband (300 to 400 nm) or 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m² narrowband (340 nm), black-standard temperature 65 ± 3 °C and relative humidity 50 ± 10 %, as given in Table A6-1.
quote: TM1 - Black-standard thermometer Cycle No. according to EN ISO 4892-2:2013 Exposure period Irradiance Black-standard temperature °C Relative humidity %
condition: Test method TM1 (Black-standard thermometer) is selected
test_case: Check test chamber logs; pass if cycle, irradiance, black-standard temperature and humidity stayed within the Table A6-1 TM1 values.
merged: When test method TM2 (Black-panel thermometer) is used, the samples shall be exposed with cycle No. 4 according to EN ISO 4892-2:2013: 102 min dry and 18 min water spray, irradiance 60 ± 2 W/m² broadband (300 to 400 nm) or 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m² narrowband (340 nm), black-panel temperature 63 ± 3 °C and relative humidity 50 ± 10 %, as given in Table A6-1.

text: Preparation of test specimens for accelerated artificial weathering shall be in accordance with the general guidelines given in EN ISO 4892-2:2013.
quote: Preparation of test specimens shall be in accordance with the general guidelines given in EN ISO 4892-2:2013.
test_case: Review specimen preparation records; pass if preparation followed EN ISO 4892-2:2013 guidelines.

text: A test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied for the resistance to fuels test of a retro-reflective device.
quote: A test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied for either:
test_case: Verify the test mixture composition is 70 vol.% n-heptane and 30 vol.% toluol before the fuel resistance test.

text: After about five minutes following wiping with the test mixture, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
quote: After about five minutes, the surface shall be inspected visually. It must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks
test_case: Visually inspect the surface about five minutes after wiping; pass if no apparent surface changes other than slight surface cracks.

text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.
quote: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth
test_case: Lightly wipe the outer and illuminating surface with a cotton cloth soaked in the n-heptane/toluol mixture and record the procedure.

text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB, after the lubricating oil resistance test the RI of the retro-reflective device shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
quote: The RI shall then be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
test_case: Measure the RI after the oil test per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. and confirm it meets the limits set there.

text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.
quote: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.
test_case: Wipe the outer and illuminating surfaces of the retro-reflector lightly with a cotton cloth soaked in detergent lubricating oil; confirm the step is recorded in the test report.

text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB, after about 5 minutes of exposure to the detergent lubricating oil, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be cleaned.
quote: After about 5 minutes, the surface shall be cleaned.
test_case: After about 5 minutes of oil exposure, clean the retro-reflector surface; confirm timing and cleaning are recorded.

text: The approval number shall be placed close to, but in any position in relation to, the circle surrounding the letter "E".
quote: The above approval number must be placed close to, but in any position in relation to, the circle surrounding the letter "E".
test_case: Inspect the approval mark on the retro-reflector and confirm that the approval number is placed close to the circle surrounding the letter "E".

text: The digits constituting the approval number shall face the same way as the "E".
quote: The digits constituting the approval number must face the same way as the "E".
test_case: Inspect the approval mark and confirm that the digits of the approval number have the same orientation as the letter "E".

text: The group of symbols indicating the class shall be diametrically opposite the approval number.
quote: The group of symbols indicating the class must be diametrically opposite the approval number.
test_case: Inspect the approval mark and confirm that the class symbol (e.g. IA or IB) is positioned diametrically opposite the approval number with respect to the circle.
